jobs.title: DBA team leader
jobs.description:
General Info

· Department: IT & Digital – Database Administration
· Work time Percentage: 100%
· Location: Switzerland, Geneva

Our Company

Our Purpose and Mission

Job Description

As DBA Team Leader, you will lead EFG’s database administration function and be accountable for the availability, security, performance, resilience, and lifecycle management of the bank’s database platforms. This role combines hands-on technical leadership with people management, service ownership, operational governance, capacity planning, automation, and continuous improvement.

You will oversee a heterogeneous database landscape (including Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL and Azure database services), ensuring robust support for business‑critical banking applications, regulatory requirements, and strategic transformation projects. You will also drive database optimisation and innovation, contributing to the evolution of EFG’s database strategy across on‑premises, hybrid, and cloud environments.

The position is based in Geneva and may require participation in an on‑call rotation and occasional work during weekends to support planned activities and critical incidents.

Key 
• Responsibilities

· Lead, coach, and develop the DBA team, setting priorities, allocating work, and ensuring appropriate skills coverage, mentoring, and knowledge transfer.

· Own the operational delivery and lifecycle management of the bank’s Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL and Azure database services, ensuring stable and efficient platforms for business‑critical systems.

· Define, implement, and enforce standards for database architecture, engineering, security, backup and recovery, monitoring, patching, and performance, in line with regulatory, risk, and audit expectations.

· Ensure database availability, resilience, capacity, and recoverability in accordance with agreed service levels and business continuity requirements, including high‑availability and disaster‑recovery architectures (e.g. Oracle Exadata, Oracle Data Guard).

· Lead incident, problem, and change management activities for database services, including root‑cause analysis, preventive actions, and clear communication to IT management and key stakeholders.

· Drive performance tuning, capacity planning, upgrades, migrations, platform consolidation, and cloud adoption initiatives, supporting the bank’s digital and data strategy.

· Maintain effective controls for privileged access, vulnerability remediation, data protection, audit evidence, and compliance, in close collaboration with Information Security, Risk, and Compliance functions.

· Partner with Application Development, Infrastructure, Cloud, Architecture, Security, and Project Management teams to design and deliver secure, scalable, and supportable database solutions for new and existing applications.

· Manage relationships with external service providers and vendors, including licences, maintenance contracts, and database‑related budgets, within the agreed governance framework.

· Organise and participate in the on‑call rotation, ensuring appropriate operational coverage and readiness, and provide senior escalation support for complex database issues and business‑critical projects.

Requirements and 
• Qualifications

Education
· Minimum: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
· Preferred: Postgraduate degree and/or relevant professional certifications in database technologies or cloud platforms are an advantage.

Professional Experience
· Minimum of 10 years of experience in database administration in complex, high‑availability environments, ideally within financial services or similarly regulated industries.
· Several years of proven experience in a technical leadership and/or people‑management role, leading DBA teams or similar infrastructure teams.
· Demonstrated track record in managing mission‑critical database platforms supporting core business applications and regulatory requirements.

Technical and Functional Knowledge
· Advanced, hands‑on expertise in Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server administration, including installation, configuration, performance tuning, backup and recovery, and troubleshooting.
· Practical experience with MySQL and PostgreSQL; exposure to heterogeneous database environments is a strong asset.
· Strong experience with Oracle Exadata, Oracle Data Guard, and high‑availability and disaster‑recovery architectures.
· Deep understanding of database architecture, performance optimisation, capacity management, security, resilience, and platform lifecycle management.
· Experience with Azure SQL Database and other Azure data services, including hybrid and cloud migration scenarios, is highly desirable.
· Proficiency with scripting and automation tools used to standardise and improve database operations and monitoring.
· Strong service ownership mindset, with proven capabilities in planning, vendor management, risk management, and decision‑making.
· Excellent communication and stakeholder‑management skills, with the ability to explain technical risks, options, and recommendations to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
· Ability to remain composed, provide clear leadership, and make sound decisions during critical incidents in high‑availability, business‑critical environments.
· Willingness and flexibility to lead and participate in an on‑call rotation and to support planned work outside normal business hours, including weekends when required.

Languages
· Fluent in French and English (spoken and written). Additional languages are an asset.

Our Values

· Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement

· Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

· Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence

· Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

· Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

Please ensure to attach a cover letter to your CV when filling the application.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni generali

· Dipartimento: IT & Digital – Amministrazione Database
· Tempo di lavoro Percentuale: 100%
· Ubicazione: Svizzera, Ginevra

La nostra azienda

Il nostro scopo e missione

Descrizione del lavoro

Come Leader del Team DBA, guiderai la funzione di amministrazione del database di EFG e sarai responsabile per la disponibilità, la sicurezza, le prestazioni, la resilienza e la gestione del ciclo di vita delle piattaforme di database della banca. Questo ruolo combina la leadership tecnica pratica con la gestione delle persone, la proprietà dei servizi, la governance operativa, la pianificazione delle capacità, l'automazione e il miglioramento continuo.

Potrai supervisionare un paesaggio di database eterogeneo (tra cui servizi database Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL e Azure), garantendo un supporto robusto per applicazioni bancarie business-critical, requisiti normativi e progetti di trasformazione strategica. Potrai anche guidare l'ottimizzazione e l'innovazione del database, contribuendo all'evoluzione della strategia di database di EFG in ambienti on-premise, ibridi e cloud.

La posizione si basa a Ginevra e può richiedere la partecipazione a una rotazione su chiamata e occasionali lavori durante il fine settimana per sostenere attività pianificate e incidenti critici.

chiave
• responsabilità

· Guidare, allenare e sviluppare il team DBA, stabilire le priorità, assegnare il lavoro, e garantire una copertura adeguata delle competenze, mentoring e trasferimento delle conoscenze.

· Possedere la consegna operativa e la gestione del ciclo di vita dei servizi database Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL e Azure della banca, garantendo piattaforme stabili ed efficienti per sistemi business-critical.

· Definire, implementare e rispettare gli standard per l'architettura del database, l'ingegneria, la sicurezza, il backup e il recupero, il monitoraggio, la patch e le prestazioni, in linea con le aspettative di regolazione, rischio e audit.

· Assicurare la disponibilità, la resilienza, la capacità e la recuperabilità dei database in conformità ai livelli di servizio concordati e ai requisiti di continuità aziendale, tra cui architetture ad alta disponibilità e di ripristino dei disastri (ad esempio Oracle Exadata, Oracle Data Guard).

· Guidare le attività di gestione degli incidenti, dei problemi e dei cambiamenti per i servizi di database, tra cui analisi, azioni preventive e comunicazione chiara alla gestione IT e agli stakeholder chiave.

· Drive performance tuning, pianificazione della capacità, aggiornamenti, migrazioni, consolidazione della piattaforma e iniziative di adozione cloud, supportando la strategia digitale e dati della banca.

· Mantenere controlli efficaci per l'accesso privilegiato, la riparazione delle vulnerabilità, la protezione dei dati, le prove di audit e la conformità, in stretta collaborazione con le funzioni di sicurezza dell'informazione, rischio e conformità.

· Partner con i team di Application Development, Infrastructure, Cloud, Architecture, Security e Project Management per progettare e fornire soluzioni di database sicure, scalabili e supportabili per applicazioni nuove e esistenti.

· Gestire relazioni con fornitori di servizi esterni e fornitori, tra cui licenze, contratti di manutenzione e budget correlati alla banca dati, all'interno del quadro di governance concordato.

· Organizzare e partecipare alla rotazione on-call, assicurando una corretta copertura operativa e prontezza, e fornire supporto di escalation senior per problemi di database complessi e progetti business-critical.

Requisiti e
• Qualifiche

Istruzione
· Minimo: laurea in Informatica, Tecnologia dell'informazione, o un campo correlato.
· Preferito: laurea post-laurea e/o certificazioni professionali rilevanti nelle tecnologie di database o piattaforme cloud sono un vantaggio.

Esperienza professionale
· Minimo di 10 anni di esperienza nell'amministrazione di database in ambienti complessi e ad alta disponibilità, idealmente all'interno di servizi finanziari o industrie similarmente regolamentate.
· Diversi anni di esperienza comprovata in un ruolo di leadership tecnica e/o di gestione delle persone, team DBA leader o team di infrastrutture simili.
· Demonstrated track record nella gestione di piattaforme di database mission-critical che supportano applicazioni core business e requisiti normativi.

Conoscenza tecnica e funzionale
· Avanzate, competenze pratiche nell'amministrazione Oracle e Microsoft SQL Server, tra cui installazione, configurazione, tuning delle prestazioni, backup e ripristino e risoluzione dei problemi.
· Esperienza pratica con MySQL e PostgreSQL; l'esposizione agli ambienti di database eterogenei è un bene forte.
· Forte esperienza con Oracle Exadata, Oracle Data Guard, e architetture ad alta disponibilità e di ripristino dei disastri.
· Profonda comprensione dell'architettura del database, ottimizzazione delle prestazioni, gestione della capacità, sicurezza, resilienza e gestione del ciclo di vita della piattaforma.
· L'esperienza con Azure SQL Database e altri servizi dati Azure, compresi gli scenari di migrazione ibrida e cloud, è altamente auspicabile.
· Proficienza con strumenti di scrittura e automazione utilizzati per standardizzare e migliorare le operazioni e il monitoraggio del database.
· Forte mentalità di proprietà del servizio, con comprovate capacità di pianificazione, gestione del fornitore, gestione del rischio e processo decisionale.
· Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder, con la capacità di spiegare i rischi tecnici, le opzioni e le raccomandazioni al pubblico tecnico e non tecnico.
· Capacità di rimanere composto, fornire una chiara leadership e prendere decisioni sonore durante incidenti critici in ambienti ad alta disponibilità, business-critical.
· Volontà e flessibilità per guidare e partecipare a una rotazione on-call e sostenere il lavoro pianificato al di fuori delle normali ore di lavoro, compresi i fine settimana quando richiesto.

Lingue
· Fluente in francese e inglese (spoken e scritto). Le lingue aggiuntive sono un bene.

I nostri valori

· Responsabilità: Prendere la proprietà per i compiti e le sfide, nonché cercare un miglioramento continuo

· Hands-on: essere proattivi per fornire rapidamente risultati di alta qualità

· Passionato: Impegnarsi e lottare per l'eccellenza

· Soluzione-driven: Focusing sui risultati del cliente e il trattamento dei clienti abbastanza con una mentalità di rischio-consapevole

· Partnership-oriented: promuovere la collaborazione e il lavoro di squadra. Lavorare insieme a uno spirito imprenditoriale.

Assicurarsi di allegare una lettera di copertura al vostro CV durante la compilazione dell'applicazione.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Allgemeine Informationen

· Abteilung: IT & Digital – Datenbankverwaltung
· Arbeitszeit Prozentsatz: 100%
· Standort: Schweiz, Genf

Unser Unternehmen

Unser Ziel und unsere Mission

Stellenbeschreibung

Als DBA Team Leader leiten Sie die Datenbankverwaltung der EFG und sind für die Verfügbarkeit, Sicherheit, Performance, Resilienz und das Lifecycle Management der Datenbankplattformen der Bank verantwortlich. Diese Rolle kombiniert praktische technische Führung mit Personalmanagement, Service Ownership, operativer Governance, Kapazitätsplanung, Automatisierung und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung.

Sie überwachen eine heterogene Datenbanklandschaft (einschließlich Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL und Azure-Datenbankdienste) und gewährleisten eine robuste Unterstützung für geschäftskritische Bankanwendungen, regulatorische Anforderungen und strategische Transformationsprojekte. Sie werden auch die Datenbankoptimierung und -innovation vorantreiben und zur Weiterentwicklung der Datenbankstrategie von EFG in On-Premises-, Hybrid- und Cloud-Umgebungen beitragen.

Die Stelle hat ihren Sitz in Genf und kann die Teilnahme an einer Bereitschaftsrotation und gelegentliche Arbeit am Wochenende erfordern, um geplante Aktivitäten und kritische Vorfälle zu unterstützen.

Schlüssel
• Zuständigkeiten

Führen, coachen und entwickeln Sie das DBA-Team, setzen Sie Prioritäten, weisen Sie die Arbeit zu und gewährleisten Sie angemessene Qualifikationen, Mentoring und Wissenstransfer.

· Eigentümer der operativen Bereitstellung und des Lifecycle-Managements der Oracle-, SQL Server-, MySQL-, PostgreSQL- und Azure-Datenbankdienste der Bank, um stabile und effiziente Plattformen für geschäftskritische Systeme zu gewährleisten.

Definieren, implementieren und erzwingen Sie Standards für Datenbankarchitektur, Engineering, Sicherheit, Backup und Wiederherstellung, Überwachung, Patching und Leistung im Einklang mit regulatorischen, Risiko- und Auditerwartungen.

· Sicherstellung der Verfügbarkeit, Belastbarkeit, Kapazität und Wiederherstellbarkeit von Datenbanken in Übereinstimmung mit vereinbarten Service-Levels und Geschäftskontinuitätsanforderungen, einschließlich Hochverfügbarkeits- und Disaster-Recovery-Architekturen (z. B. Oracle Exadata, Oracle Data Guard).

· Leitung von Incident-, Problem- und Change-Management-Aktivitäten für Datenbankdienste, einschließlich Ursachenanalyse, Präventivmaßnahmen und klarer Kommunikation mit dem IT-Management und den wichtigsten Stakeholdern.

· Steigerung von Performance-Tuning, Kapazitätsplanung, Upgrades, Migrationen, Plattformkonsolidierung und Cloud-Adoptionsinitiativen zur Unterstützung der Digital- und Datenstrategie der Bank.

· Aufrechterhaltung wirksamer Kontrollen für privilegierten Zugriff, Schwachstellenbeseitigung, Datenschutz, Prüfungsnachweise und Compliance in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Funktionen für Informationssicherheit, Risiko und Compliance.

· Zusammenarbeit mit Teams für Anwendungsentwicklung, Infrastruktur, Cloud, Architektur, Sicherheit und Projektmanagement, um sichere, skalierbare und unterstützende Datenbanklösungen für neue und bestehende Anwendungen zu entwerfen und bereitzustellen.

· Verwaltung der Beziehungen zu externen Dienstleistern und Anbietern, einschließlich Lizenzen, Wartungsverträgen und datenbankbezogenen Budgets, innerhalb des vereinbarten Governance-Rahmens.

· Organisation und Teilnahme an der On-Call-Rotation, Gewährleistung einer angemessenen operativen Abdeckung und Einsatzbereitschaft sowie Unterstützung bei der Eskalation bei komplexen Datenbankproblemen und geschäftskritischen Projekten.

Anforderungen und
• Qualifikationen

Bildung
· Minimum: Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Informationstechnologie oder einem verwandten Bereich.
Bevorzugt: Postgraduierten-Abschluss und/oder relevante professionelle Zertifizierungen in Datenbanktechnologien oder Cloud-Plattformen sind von Vorteil.

Berufserfahrung
· Mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung in der Datenbankverwaltung in komplexen, hochverfügbaren Umgebungen, idealerweise in Finanzdienstleistungen oder ähnlich regulierten Branchen.
Mehrjährige nachgewiesene Erfahrung in einer technischen Führungs- und/oder Personalführungsrolle, in der Leitung von DBA-Teams oder ähnlichen Infrastrukturteams.
· Nachweis der Erfolgsbilanz bei der Verwaltung unternehmenskritischer Datenbankplattformen, die Kerngeschäftsanwendungen und regulatorische Anforderungen unterstützen.

Technisches und funktionales Wissen
Erweiterte praktische Expertise in der Oracle- und Microsoft SQL Server-Administration, einschließlich Installation, Konfiguration, Performance-Tuning, Backup und Wiederherstellung sowie Fehlerbehebung.
Praktische Erfahrung mit MySQL und PostgreSQL; die Exposition gegenüber heterogenen Datenbankumgebungen ist ein starker Vorteil.
Starke Erfahrung mit Oracle Exadata, Oracle Data Guard und hochverfügbaren und Disaster-Recovery-Architekturen.
Tiefes Verständnis von Datenbankarchitektur, Leistungsoptimierung, Kapazitätsmanagement, Sicherheit, Resilienz und Platform Lifecycle Management.
· Erfahrungen mit Azure SQL Database und anderen Azure-Datendiensten, einschließlich Hybrid- und Cloud-Migrationsszenarien, sind sehr wünschenswert.
· Kenntnisse in Skript- und Automatisierungstools zur Standardisierung und Verbesserung von Datenbankbetrieb und -überwachung.
Starke Service Ownership-Mentalität mit bewährten Fähigkeiten in den Bereichen Planung, Lieferantenmanagement, Risikomanagement und Entscheidungsfindung.
Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, technische Risiken, Optionen und Empfehlungen sowohl für technische als auch für nicht-technische Zielgruppen zu erklären.
· Fähigkeit, sich zusammenzuhalten, eine klare Führung zu übernehmen und bei kritischen Vorfällen in geschäftskritischen Umgebungen mit hoher Verfügbarkeit fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen.
· Bereitschaft und Flexibilität, eine On-Call-Rotation zu leiten und sich daran zu beteiligen und geplante Arbeiten außerhalb der normalen Geschäftszeiten zu unterstützen, gegebenenfalls auch an Wochenenden.

Sprachen
· fließend in Französisch und Englisch (gesprochen und geschrieben). Zusätzliche Sprachen sind ein Gewinn.

Unsere Werte

· Verantwortlichkeit: Übernahme von Verantwortung für Aufgaben und Herausforderungen sowie Suche nach kontinuierlicher Verbesserung

Hands-on: Proaktiv sein, um schnell qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse zu liefern

· Leidenschaftlich: Engagiert sein und nach Exzellenz streben

Lösungsorientiert: Fokussierung auf Kundenergebnisse und faire Behandlung von Kunden mit einer risikobewussten Denkweise

· Partnerschaftsorientiert: Förderung von Zusammenarbeit und Teamwork. Zusammenarbeit mit Unternehmergeist.

Bitte stellen Sie sicher, dass Sie Ihrem Lebenslauf beim Ausfüllen des Antrags ein Anschreiben beifügen.

Informations générales

· Département: IT & Digital – Administration de la base de données
· Temps de travail Pourcentage: 100%
· Lieu: Suisse, Genève

Notre société

Notre but et notre mission

Description de l'emploi

En tant que chef d'équipe du DBA, vous dirigerez la fonction d'administration de la base de données EFG. Ce rôle combine le leadership technique pratique avec la gestion des personnes, la propriété des services, la gouvernance opérationnelle, la planification des capacités, l'automatisation et l'amélioration continue.

Vous superviserez un paysage hétérogène de bases de données (notamment Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL et Azure), assurant un support solide pour les applications bancaires critiques pour les entreprises, les exigences réglementaires et les projets de transformation stratégique. Vous piloterez également l'optimisation et l'innovation des bases de données, contribuant ainsi à l'évolution de la stratégie de base de données EFG à travers les environnements sur site, hybride et cloud.

Le poste est basé à Genève et peut nécessiter la participation à une rotation sur appel et des travaux occasionnels pendant les week-ends pour soutenir les activités prévues et les incidents critiques.

Clé
• Responsabilités

· Diriger, entraîner et développer l'équipe de l'ACD, établir des priorités, répartir le travail et assurer une couverture adéquate des compétences, le mentorat et le transfert des connaissances.

· Posséder la livraison opérationnelle et la gestion du cycle de vie des services de base de données Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL et Azure, en assurant la stabilité et l'efficacité des plateformes pour les systèmes critiques pour les entreprises.

· Définir, mettre en oeuvre et appliquer des normes d'architecture de base de données, d'ingénierie, de sécurité, de sauvegarde et de récupération, de surveillance, de correction et de rendement, conformément aux attentes en matière de réglementation, de risque et de vérification.

· Assurer la disponibilité, la résilience, la capacité et la récupération des bases de données conformément aux niveaux de service convenus et aux exigences en matière de continuité des activités, y compris les architectures de grande disponibilité et de récupération des catastrophes (p. ex. Oracle Exadata, Oracle Data Guard).

· Diriger les activités de gestion des incidents, des problèmes et du changement pour les services de base de données, y compris l'analyse des causes profondes, les mesures préventives et la communication claire à la gestion de la TI et aux intervenants clés.

· Diriger le réglage des performances, la planification des capacités, les mises à niveau, les migrations, la consolidation des plateformes et les initiatives d'adoption du cloud, en soutenant la stratégie numérique et de données de la banque.

· Maintenir des contrôles efficaces pour l'accès privilégié, l'assainissement de la vulnérabilité, la protection des données, les éléments probants et la conformité, en étroite collaboration avec les fonctions de sécurité de l'information, de risque et de conformité.

· S'associer à des équipes de développement d'applications, d'infrastructure, de cloud, d'architecture, de sécurité et de gestion de projet pour concevoir et fournir des solutions de base de données sécurisées, évolutives et supportables pour les applications nouvelles et existantes.

· Gérer les relations avec les fournisseurs de services externes et les fournisseurs, y compris les licences, les contrats de maintenance et les budgets liés aux bases de données, dans le cadre de gouvernance convenu.

· Organiser et participer à la rotation sur appel, assurer une couverture opérationnelle et une préparation appropriées, et fournir un soutien d'escalade senior pour les questions complexes de bases de données et les projets critiques pour les entreprises.

Exigences et
• Compétences

Éducation
· Minimum: Baccalauréat en informatique, en technologie de l'information ou dans un domaine connexe.
· Préféré: Le diplôme d'études supérieures et/ou les certifications professionnelles pertinentes dans les technologies de base de données ou les plateformes cloud sont un avantage.

Expérience professionnelle
· Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans l'administration des bases de données dans des environnements complexes et à forte disponibilité, idéalement dans les services financiers ou dans des industries réglementées de la même façon.
· Plusieurs années d'expérience éprouvée dans un rôle de leadership technique et/ou de gestion des personnes, dirigeant des équipes DBA ou des équipes d'infrastructure similaires.
· Expérience démontrée dans la gestion des plateformes de base de données essentielles à la mission, qui appuient les applications opérationnelles essentielles et les exigences réglementaires.

Connaissances techniques et fonctionnelles
· Expertise avancée et pratique dans l'administration d'Oracle et de Microsoft SQL Server, y compris installation, configuration, réglage des performances, sauvegarde et récupération, et dépannage.

Our Company

EFG International is a global private banking group, offering private banking and asset management services. We serve clients in over 40 locations worldwide. Joining our team means experiencing a supportive environment, where your contributions are valued and recognised. We strongly believe that the diversity of our teams gives us a competitive advantage by fostering better decision-making and greater innovation.

Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future. We are a private bank, offering personalised solutions on a global scale to private and institutional clients. Our sustainable success is based on our talents and on how we partner with our clients and communities to create lasting value.

Job Description

As DBA Team Leader, you will lead EFG’s database administration function and be accountable for the availability, security, performance, resilience, and lifecycle management of the bank’s database platforms. This role combines hands-on technical leadership with people management, service ownership, operational governance, capacity planning, automation, and continuous improvement.

You will oversee a heterogeneous database landscape (including Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL and Azure database services), ensuring robust support for business‑critical banking applications, regulatory requirements, and strategic transformation projects. You will also drive database optimisation and innovation, contributing to the evolution of EFG’s database strategy across on‑premises, hybrid, and cloud environments.

The position is based in Geneva and may require participation in an on‑call rotation and occasional work during weekends to support planned activities and critical incidents.

Key Responsibilities

· Lead, coach, and develop the DBA team, setting priorities, allocating work, and ensuring appropriate skills coverage, mentoring, and knowledge transfer.

· Own the operational delivery and lifecycle management of the bank’s Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL and Azure database services, ensuring stable and efficient platforms for business‑critical systems.

· Define, implement, and enforce standards for database architecture, engineering, security, backup and recovery, monitoring, patching, and performance, in line with regulatory, risk, and audit expectations.

· Ensure database availability, resilience, capacity, and recoverability in accordance with agreed service levels and business continuity requirements, including high‑availability and disaster‑recovery architectures (e.g. Oracle Exadata, Oracle Data Guard).

· Lead incident, problem, and change management activities for database services, including root‑cause analysis, preventive actions, and clear communication to IT management and key stakeholders.

· Drive performance tuning, capacity planning, upgrades, migrations, platform consolidation, and cloud adoption initiatives, supporting the bank’s digital and data strategy.

· Maintain effective controls for privileged access, vulnerability remediation, data protection, audit evidence, and compliance, in close collaboration with Information Security, Risk, and Compliance functions.

· Partner with Application Development, Infrastructure, Cloud, Architecture, Security, and Project Management teams to design and deliver secure, scalable, and supportable database solutions for new and existing applications.

· Manage relationships with external service providers and vendors, including licences, maintenance contracts, and database‑related budgets, within the agreed governance framework.

· Organise and participate in the on‑call rotation, ensuring appropriate operational coverage and readiness, and provide senior escalation support for complex database issues and business‑critical projects.

Requirements and Qualifications

Education
· Minimum: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
· Preferred: Postgraduate degree and/or relevant professional certifications in database technologies or cloud platforms are an advantage.

Professional Experience
· Minimum of 10 years of experience in database administration in complex, high‑availability environments, ideally within financial services or similarly regulated industries.
· Several years of proven experience in a technical leadership and/or people‑management role, leading DBA teams or similar infrastructure teams.
· Demonstrated track record in managing mission‑critical database platforms supporting core business applications and regulatory requirements.

Technical and Functional Knowledge
· Advanced, hands‑on expertise in Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server administration, including installation, configuration, performance tuning, backup and recovery, and troubleshooting.
· Practical experience with MySQL and PostgreSQL; exposure to heterogeneous database environments is a strong asset.
· Strong experience with Oracle Exadata, Oracle Data Guard, and high‑availability and disaster‑recovery architectures.
· Deep understanding of database architecture, performance optimisation, capacity management, security, resilience, and platform lifecycle management.
· Experience with Azure SQL Database and other Azure data services, including hybrid and cloud migration scenarios, is highly desirable.
· Proficiency with scripting and automation tools used to standardise and improve database operations and monitoring.
· Strong service ownership mindset, with proven capabilities in planning, vendor management, risk management, and decision‑making.
· Excellent communication and stakeholder‑management skills, with the ability to explain technical risks, options, and recommendations to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
· Ability to remain composed, provide clear leadership, and make sound decisions during critical incidents in high‑availability, business‑critical environments.
· Willingness and flexibility to lead and participate in an on‑call rotation and to support planned work outside normal business hours, including weekends when required.

Languages

Our Values

· Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement

· Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

· Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence

· Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

jobs.description:
General Info

- Department: Information Security & Business Continuity Management – Information Security Third Party Risk Management

- Work time Percentage: 100%- 12 months temporary contract

- Location: Zurich

Our Company

Our Purpose and Mission

Job Description

We are looking for a temporary (12 month contract) experienced Information Security Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) professional to lead the end‑to‑end TPRM lifecycle for EFG Group. In this Zurich‑based role, you will act as the primary process owner for our global TPRM framework and platform, covering onboarding, risk assessment, due diligence, ongoing monitoring and offboarding of third‑party providers and outsourced services.

Operating within the Information Security & Business Continuity function, you will work autonomously on complex, cross‑functional topics and provide expert challenge and guidance to Procurement, Legal, Compliance, Operational Risk, Business Owners and Business Continuity across multiple jurisdictions. Reporting to the TPRM Manager (under the Group Chief Information Security Officer), you will play a key role in shaping the Group’s medium‑term (1–5 year) third‑party risk posture and control environment, directly influencing decisions that affect operational continuity and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the end‑to‑end onboarding process for new third parties and services in scope of TPRM, ensuring inherent risk assessment, due diligence and approvals are completed before contract signature or service go‑live.

- Design and apply robust inherent risk scoping for new and existing third‑party relationships, assessing data sensitivity, service criticality, outsourcing status, location and concentration risk to determine the required level of oversight.

- Direct and coordinate due diligence activities with key control functions (Information Security, Compliance, Legal, Operational Risk, Business Continuity, Procurement), ensuring all relevant risk domains are covered and issues are clearly documented, owned and tracked.

- Conduct and critically challenge third‑party risk assessments across information security, data protection, operational resilience, financial, compliance and ESG (where applicable), interpreting questionnaires, evidence and certifications using sound professional judgement.

- Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of third‑party controls, identify gaps and issues, and agree risk‑based remediation actions, timelines and residual risk positions with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, with the third party.

- Classify third parties into risk tiers and criticality levels based on defined criteria, ensuring that monitoring activities, review frequency and escalation thresholds are aligned with the assigned tier.

- Lead the implementation and maintenance of ongoing monitoring plans for in‑scope third parties, including periodic reassessments, recertifications (e.g. annual or trigger‑based reviews) and event‑driven reviews following incidents or material changes.

- Own the configuration and continuous improvement of the TPRM platform, including workflows, questionnaires, scoring models, data structures and user roles, to support efficient, consistent and data‑driven risk management.

- Design and deliver training, guidance and communication on TPRM processes, platform usage and good practices to Business Owners and control functions, strengthening risk awareness and consistent application of the framework across the Group.

- Act as a central point of contact and trusted advisor for Business Owners, Procurement, Legal, Information Security, Compliance and Business Continuity on TPRM matters, including review of contractual clauses (e.g. audit rights, data protection, subcontracting, exit and resilience) and influencing risk‑based decisions.

Requirements and Qualifications

Education

- Minimum:
- High school diploma or equivalent, combined with substantial relevant professional experience in information security, risk management, technology, finance or business.

- Preferred:
- University degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Finance or a related discipline.

Professional Certifications / Licences

- Preferred:
- Relevant professional certifications in information security or risk management (for example in areas such as information security management, risk management or ISO 27001), where applicable to the jurisdiction.

Professional Experience

- At least 10 years of experience in information security, risk management, vendor/third‑party management or closely related fields, ideally in a global or multi‑jurisdictional environment.

- Proven, hands‑on experience in Third Party Risk Management, including outsourcing, critical services, data protection, information security and operational resilience in a regulated environment.

- Experience working in or with regulated financial services or similarly highly regulated sectors; banking experience is a strong advantage.

- Practical experience with a TPRM or vendor management platform, including configuration, workflow design, data structures and user support.

- Demonstrated analytical and critical‑thinking skills, with the ability to challenge information, form independent views and make clear, risk‑based recommendations on complex third‑party relationships.

- Strong organisational and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple third‑party assessments and stakeholder interactions simultaneously and to prioritise effectively under time pressure.

Technical / Functional Knowledge

- Deep knowledge of third‑party risk management frameworks, methodologies and regulatory expectations related to outsourcing, information security and operational resilience in financial services.

- Strong understanding of information security and data protection principles as they apply to third‑party arrangements, including confidentiality, integrity, availability, access management, incident management and data handling.

- Proficiency in using workflow tools, risk assessment platforms and data‑driven dashboards, with the ability to shape efficient processes and data structures within the TPRM platform.

- High level of comfort working with structured data, questionnaires and evidence repositories, with strong attention to detail and a commitment to data quality.

Languages

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex risk and security concepts in a clear, pragmatic and business‑oriented way to non‑specialist stakeholders.

- Required: Fluent English.

- Preferred: Any additional languages relevant to the role’s geographic scope are an advantage.

Our Values

- Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement

- Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

- Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence

- Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

- Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

Informazioni generali
- Dipartimento: Sicurezza dell'informazione e Gestione della continuità aziendale. Sicurezza dell'informazione Gestione del rischio di terzi
- Tempo di lavoro Percentuale: 100%- 12 mesi contratto temporaneo
- Location: Zurich

La nostra azienda

Il nostro scopo e missione

Descrizione del lavoro

Stiamo cercando un contratto temporaneo (12 mesi) con esperienza nel settore della sicurezza delle informazioni, un professionista del Risk Management (TPRM) per guidare il ciclo di vita del TPRM end-to-end per il Gruppo EFG. In questo ruolo basato su Zurigo, agirai come proprietario principale del processo per il nostro quadro e piattaforma globale TPRM, che comprende l'imbarco, la valutazione dei rischi, la dovuta diligenza, il monitoraggio continuo e l'offboarding di fornitori terzi e servizi esternalizzati.

Operando nell'ambito della funzione Sicurezza delle informazioni e continuità aziendale, lavorerai autonomamente su temi complessi e interfunzionali e fornirai sfide e orientamenti per esperti in materia di appalti, legali, conformità, rischio operativo, proprietari di imprese e continuità aziendale attraverso più giurisdizioni. A seguito di una relazione al responsabile della sicurezza delle informazioni TPRM (sotto il responsabile della sicurezza delle informazioni del gruppo), svolgerai un ruolo chiave nella definizione del gruppo a medio termine (1,5 anni) ambiente di controllo e postura dei rischi di terzi, influenzando direttamente le decisioni che incidono sulla continuità operativa e sulla conformità normativa.

Responsabilità chiave
- Guidare il processo di imbarco end-to-end per i nuovi terzi e servizi nell'ambito della TPRM, garantendo la valutazione del rischio inerente, la dovuta diligenza e l'approvazione sono completati prima della firma del contratto o del servizio go-live.
- Progettare e applicare un solido rischio intrinseco per i rapporti con terzi nuovi ed esistenti, valutando la sensibilità dei dati, la criticità dei servizi, lo stato di outsourcing, la localizzazione e il rischio di concentrazione per determinare il livello di sorveglianza richiesto.
- Attività dirette e coordinate di due diligence con funzioni di controllo chiave (Sicurezza delle informazioni, Conformità, Rischio legale, Rischio operativo, Continuità aziendale, Appalti), assicurando che tutti i settori di rischio pertinenti siano coperti e che le questioni siano chiaramente documentate, possedute e monitorate.
- L'esecuzione e la critica delle valutazioni dei rischi di terzi sono oggetto di una valutazione critica in materia di sicurezza delle informazioni, protezione dei dati, resilienza operativa, finanziamento, conformità e SGE (se del caso), interpretando questionari, prove e certificazioni utilizzando un giudizio professionale solido.
- Evaluare la progettazione e l'efficacia operativa dei controlli di terzi, individuare lacune e problemi e concordare azioni di risanamento basate sul rischio, scadenze e posizioni di rischio residue con le parti interessate interne e, se del caso, con le parti terze.
- Classificare i terzi in livelli di rischio e livelli di criticità basati su criteri definiti, assicurando che le attività di monitoraggio, la frequenza di riesame e le soglie di aumento siano allineate con il livello assegnato.
- Guidare l'attuazione e il mantenimento di piani di monitoraggio in corso per i terzi in ambito, comprese revisioni periodiche, ricertificazioni (ad esempio revisioni annuali o basate su fattori di attivazione) e revisioni basate su eventi a seguito di incidenti o modifiche materiali.
- Possedere la configurazione e il miglioramento continuo della piattaforma TPRM, compresi flussi di lavoro, questionari, modelli di punteggio, strutture dati e ruoli degli utenti, per supportare una gestione efficiente, coerente e basata sui dati del rischio.
- Progettare e fornire formazione, orientamento e comunicazione sui processi TPRM, l'utilizzo delle piattaforme e le buone pratiche per i proprietari di imprese e le funzioni di controllo, rafforzando la consapevolezza dei rischi e l'applicazione coerente del framework in tutto il Gruppo.
- Agire come punto di contatto centrale e consulente di fiducia per i proprietari di imprese, gli appalti, la sicurezza giuridica, l'informazione, la conformità e la continuità aziendale in materia di TPRM, compresa la revisione delle clausole contrattuali (ad esempio diritti di audit, protezione dei dati, subappalto, uscita e resilienza) e influenzare le decisioni basate sul rischio.

Requisiti e qualifiche

Istruzione
- Minimo:
- Diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente, combinato con una notevole esperienza professionale in materia di sicurezza dell'informazione, gestione dei rischi, tecnologia, finanza o attività.
- Preferito:
- Laurea in Sicurezza dell'Informazione, Informatica, Ingegneria, Affari, Finanza o disciplina correlata.

Certificazioni professionali / Licenze
- Preferito:
- Le certificazioni professionali pertinenti in materia di sicurezza delle informazioni o di gestione dei rischi (ad esempio in settori quali la gestione della sicurezza delle informazioni, la gestione dei rischi o la norma ISO 27001), se applicabili alla giurisdizione.

Esperienza professionale
- Almeno 10 anni di esperienza in materia di sicurezza dell'informazione, gestione dei rischi, gestione dei fornitori/terzi o campi strettamente correlati, idealmente in un ambiente globale o multigiurisdizionale.
- Proven, esperienza pratica nella gestione dei rischi di terzi, tra cui l'outsourcing, i servizi critici, la protezione dei dati, la sicurezza delle informazioni e la resilienza operativa in un ambiente regolamentato.
- L'esperienza lavorativa in servizi finanziari regolamentati o in settori analoghi altamente regolamentati è un forte vantaggio.
- Esperienza pratica con una piattaforma di gestione TPRM o vendor, tra cui configurazione, progettazione del flusso di lavoro, strutture dati e supporto utente.
- Capacità analitiche e di pensiero critico, con la capacità di mettere in discussione le informazioni, di formare opinioni indipendenti e di formulare raccomandazioni chiare e basate sul rischio su complesse relazioni con terzi.
- Forte capacità organizzative e di coordinamento, con la capacità di gestire contemporaneamente valutazioni multiple di terzi e interazioni con le parti interessate e di dare priorità efficacemente sotto pressione temporale.

Conoscenze tecniche/funzionali
- Conoscenza approfondita dei quadri, delle metodologie e delle aspettative di regolamentazione in materia di outsourcing, sicurezza dell'informazione e resilienza operativa dei servizi finanziari di terzi.
- Una forte comprensione dei principi di sicurezza delle informazioni e di protezione dei dati in quanto si applicano agli accordi di terzi, tra cui riservatezza, integrità, disponibilità, gestione degli accessi, gestione degli incidenti e trattamento dei dati.
- Professionalità nell'utilizzo di strumenti di flusso di lavoro, piattaforme di valutazione dei rischi e dashboard basati sui dati, con la capacità di modellare processi efficienti e strutture dati all'interno della piattaforma TPRM.
- Alto livello di comfort lavorando con dati strutturati, questionari e repository di prove, con una forte attenzione ai dettagli e un impegno per la qualità dei dati.

Lingue
- Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale, con la capacità di spiegare concetti complessi di rischio e sicurezza in modo chiaro, pragmatico e orientato alle imprese, agli attori non specializzati.
- Richiesto: Inglese fluente.
- Preferito: Ogni lingua aggiuntiva relativa al ruolo.s campo di applicazione geografico sono un vantaggio.

I nostri valori
- Responsabilità: prendere in considerazione compiti e sfide, nonché cercare un miglioramento continuo
- Hands-on: essere proattivi per fornire rapidamente risultati di alta qualità
- Appassionato: Impegnarsi e lottare per l'eccellenza
- Soluzione guidata: Concentrarsi sui risultati dei clienti e trattare i clienti in modo equo con una mentalità consapevole del rischio
- Partnership-oriented: Promozione della collaborazione e del lavoro di squadra. Lavorare insieme con uno spirito imprenditoriale.

Unsere Firma

Unser Zweck und unsere Mission

Aufgabenbeschreibung

Wir suchen einen befristeten (12 Monate) Vertrag mit erfahrenem IT-Sicherheits-Profi (TPRM) für den End-to-End-TPRM-Lebenszyklus der EFG Group. In dieser Zürich-basierten Rolle werden Sie als primärer Prozesseigentümer für unser globales TPRM-Rahmenwerk und unsere Plattform fungieren, das Onboarding, Risikobewertung, Due Diligence, laufende Überwachung und Offboarding von Drittanbietern und Outsourced Services umfasst.

Sie arbeiten im Rahmen der Funktion Information Security & Business Continuity selbstständig an komplexen, funktionsübergreifenden Themen und bieten Experten-Herausforderung und Orientierung für Beschaffung, Recht, Compliance, Operational Risk, Business Owners und Business Continuity über mehrere Länder hinweg. Sie werden dem TPRM-Manager (unter dem Group Chief Information Security Officer) eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung der mittelfristigen (1-5 Jahre) Risikohaltung und Kontrollumgebung von Drittanbietern spielen und Entscheidungen direkt beeinflussen, die die operative Kontinuität und die regulatorische Compliance beeinflussen.

Wichtige Aufgaben
- Führen Sie das End-to-End-Onboarding-Verfahren für neue Dritte und Dienstleistungen im Rahmen von TPRM, wobei die inhärente Risikobewertung, die Due Diligence und die Zulassungen vor Vertragsunterzeichnung oder Vertragsabschluss abgeschlossen werden.
- Entwurf und Anwendung robuster, inhärenter Risikoabschätzungen für neue und bestehende Beziehungen Dritter, Bewertung der Datensensibilität, der Servicekritik, des Outsourcing-Status, des Standort- und Konzentrationsrisikos, um das erforderliche Aufsichtsniveau zu bestimmen.
- Direkte und koordinierte Due Diligence-Aktivitäten mit Schlüsselfunktionen (Informationssicherheit, Compliance, Rechtliches, Operational Risk, Business Continuity, Beschaffung), die sicherstellen, dass alle relevanten Risikobereiche abgedeckt sind und Probleme klar dokumentiert, im Besitz und verfolgt werden.
- Durchführung und kritische Herausforderungen von Risikobewertungen Dritter in Bezug auf Informationssicherheit, Datenschutz, betriebliche Widerstandsfähigkeit, finanzielle und Compliance-Maßnahmen und (gegebenenfalls) ESG, Interpretation von Fragebögen, Nachweisen und Zertifizierungen unter Verwendung eines soliden professionellen Urteils.
- Bewertung der Konzeption und der Wirksamkeit der Kontrollen durch Dritte, Ermittlung von Lücken und Problemen sowie Vereinbarung risikobasierter Sanierungsmaßnahmen, Zeitpläne und Restrisikopositionen mit internen Interessenträgern und gegebenenfalls mit Dritten.
- Die Einstufung von Dritten in Risikostufen und Kritizitätsstufen auf der Grundlage definierter Kriterien gewährleistet, dass die Überwachungsmaßnahmen, die Überprüfungshäufigkeit und die Eskalationsschwellen mit der zugewiesenen Ebene abgestimmt sind.
- Führen Sie die Umsetzung und Pflege laufender Monitoringpläne für in-skopische Dritte, einschließlich periodischer Neubewertungen, Rezertifizierungen (z. B. jährliche oder triggerbasierte Überprüfungen) und ereignisorientierter Überprüfungen nach Vorfällen oder wesentlichen Änderungen.
- Die Konfiguration und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der TPRM-Plattform, einschließlich Workflows, Fragebögen, Bewertungsmodelle, Datenstrukturen und Nutzerrollen, dient der Unterstützung eines effizienten, konsistenten und datengetriebenen Risikomanagements.
- Entwerfen und liefern Schulungen, Beratung und Kommunikation über TPRM-Prozesse, Plattformnutzung und bewährte Verfahren für Unternehmer und Steuerungsfunktionen, Stärkung des Risikobewusstseins und konsequente Anwendung des Rahmens im gesamten Konzern.
- Als zentrale Anlaufstelle und vertrauenswürdiger Berater für Unternehmen, Beschaffung, Rechts- und Informationssicherheit, Compliance und Business Continuity in TPRM-Fragen tätig werden, einschließlich der Überprüfung von Vertragsklauseln (z. B. Prüfungsrechte, Datenschutz, Unterauftragsvergabe, Exit und Resilienz) und Einfluss auf risikobasierte Entscheidungen.

Anforderungen und Qualifikationen

Bildung
- Mindestanforderungen:
- High School Diplom oder gleichwertig, kombiniert mit wesentlichen relevanten Berufserfahrung in Informationssicherheit, Risikomanagement, Technologie, Finanzen oder Geschäft.
- Bevorzugt:
- Hochschulabschluss in Information Security, Informatik, Ingenieurwesen, Wirtschaft, Finanzen oder einer verwandten Disziplin.

Professionelle Zertifizierungen / Lizenzen
- Bevorzugt:
- Relevante fachliche Zertifizierungen in den Bereichen Informationssicherheit oder Risikomanagement (z. B. in Bereichen wie Informationssicherheitsmanagement, Risikomanagement oder ISO 27001), soweit für den jeweiligen Rechtsraum relevant.

Berufserfahrung
- Mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung in den Bereichen Informationssicherheit, Risikomanagement, Verkäufer/Drittanbieter-Management oder eng verwandte Bereiche, idealerweise in einem globalen oder multijurisdiktionalen Umfeld.
- Bewährte, praktische Erfahrung im Risikomanagement von Dritten, einschließlich Outsourcing, kritischer Dienste, Datenschutz, Informationssicherheit und betrieblicher Widerstandsfähigkeit in einem geregelten Umfeld.
- Erfahrung in oder mit regulierten Finanzdienstleistungen oder ähnlich stark regulierten Sektoren; Bankerfahrung ist ein starker Vorteil.
- Praktische Erfahrung mit einer TPRM- oder Anbietermanagement-Plattform, einschließlich Konfiguration, Workflow-Design, Datenstrukturen und Benutzerunterstützung.
- Nachweis analytischer und kritisch denkender Fähigkeiten, die in der Lage sind, Informationen herauszufordern, unabhängige Ansichten zu bilden und klare, risikobasierte Empfehlungen zu komplexen Beziehungen Dritter abzugeben.
- Starke organisatorische und koordinierende Fähigkeiten, die in der Lage sind, mehrere Bewertungen von Dritten und Interaktionen zwischen den Interessenträgern gleichzeitig zu verwalten und unter Zeitdruck effektiv Prioritäten zu setzen.

Technisches / funktionelles Wissen
- Vertiefung der Kenntnisse über Rahmenbedingungen für das Risikomanagement Dritter, Methoden und regulatorische Erwartungen im Zusammenhang mit Outsourcing, Informationssicherheit und betrieblicher Widerstandsfähigkeit bei Finanzdienstleistungen.
- Ein starkes Verständnis der Grundsätze der Informationssicherheit und des Datenschutzes, die für Vereinbarungen Dritter gelten, einschließlich Vertraulichkeit, Integrität, Verfügbarkeit, Zugangsmanagement, Ereignismanagement und Datenhandling.
- Kompetenz bei der Nutzung von Workflow-Tools, Risikoabschätzungsplattformen und datengetriebenen Dashboards, mit der Fähigkeit, effiziente Prozesse und Datenstrukturen innerhalb der TPRM-Plattform zu gestalten.
- Hohes Maß an Komfort bei der Arbeit mit strukturierten Daten, Fragebögen und Evidenz-Repositorien, mit großer Liebe zum Detail und einem Engagement für Datenqualität.

Sprachen
- Ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, die es ermöglichen, komplexe Risiko- und Sicherheitskonzepte klar, pragmatisch und geschäftsorientiert für nicht-spezialistische Akteure zu erklären.
- Erforderlich: Fließendes Englisch.
- Bevorzugt: Jede weitere Sprache, die für die Rolle relevant ist, ist der geografische Geltungsbereich ein Vorteil.

Unsere Werte
- Rechenschaftspflicht: Verantwortung für Aufgaben und Herausforderungen übernehmen, sowie kontinuierliche Verbesserung anstreben
- Hands-on: Proaktiv sein, um schnell qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse zu erzielen
- Leidenschaftlich: Engagement und Streben nach Exzellenz
- Lösungsorientiert: Fokussierung auf Kundenergebnisse und Behandlung von Kunden mit einer risikobewussten Mindset-Lösung
- Partnerschaftsorientiert: Förderung von Zusammenarbeit und Teamarbeit. Zusammenarbeit mit Unternehmergeist.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Informations générales
- Ministère : Sécurité de l'information et gestion de la continuité des activités – Sécurité de l'information Gestion des risques par des tiers
- Temps de travail Pourcentage: 100%- 12 mois contrat temporaire
- Lieu: Zurich

Notre société

Notre but et notre mission

Description de l'emploi

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un professionnel expérimenté en gestion des risques de tiers en matière de sécurité de l'information (TPRM) pour diriger le cycle de vie de bout en bout du TPRM pour le groupe EFG. Dans ce rôle basé à Zurich, vous agirez en tant que principal propriétaire de processus pour notre cadre et plate-forme TPRM globale, couvrant l'embarquement, l'évaluation des risques, la diligence raisonnable, le suivi continu et l'éloignement des fournisseurs tiers et des services externalisés.

Fonctionnant dans le cadre de la fonction Sécurité de l'information et continuité des activités, vous travaillerez de façon autonome sur des sujets complexes et interfonctionnels et vous fournirez des conseils et des défis spécialisés en matière d'approvisionnement, de droit, de conformité, de risque opérationnel, de propriétaires d'entreprises et de continuité des activités dans plusieurs administrations. Relevant du gestionnaire du GRPT (sous la direction du dirigeant principal de la sécurité de l'information du groupe), vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'élaboration de l'environnement de risque et de contrôle des tiers à moyen terme (1 à 5 ans) du groupe, influençant directement les décisions qui influent sur la continuité opérationnelle et la conformité réglementaire.

Principales responsabilités
- Diriger le processus d'embarquement de bout en bout pour les nouveaux tiers et services relevant de la GPT, en veillant à ce que l'évaluation des risques inhérents, la diligence raisonnable et les approbations soient terminées avant la signature du contrat ou la mise en service.
- Concevoir et appliquer une approche robuste du risque inhérent aux relations tierces nouvelles et existantes, en évaluant la sensibilité aux données, la criticité du service, le statut d'impartition, l'emplacement et le risque de concentration afin de déterminer le niveau de surveillance requis.
- Diriger et coordonner les activités de diligence raisonnable avec les principales fonctions de contrôle (sécurité de l'information, conformité, risques juridiques, opérationnels, continuité des activités, approvisionnement), s'assurer que tous les domaines de risque pertinents sont couverts et que les questions sont clairement documentées, détenues et suivies.
- Mener des évaluations des risques pour les tiers et les contester de façon critique à l'échelle de la sécurité de l'information, de la protection des données, de la résilience opérationnelle, des finances, de la conformité et de l'ESG (le cas échéant), interpréter les questionnaires, les preuves et les certifications en utilisant un jugement professionnel solide.
- Évaluer la conception et l'efficacité opérationnelle des contrôles par des tiers, cerner les lacunes et les problèmes, et convenir de mesures d'assainissement fondées sur les risques, d'échéanciers et de positions de risque résiduel avec les intervenants internes et, le cas échéant, avec les tiers.
- Classer les tiers en niveaux de risque et de criticité en fonction de critères définis, en veillant à ce que les activités de surveillance, la fréquence d'examen et les seuils d'escalade soient alignés sur le niveau attribué.
- Diriger la mise en oeuvre et la tenue à jour de plans de surveillance continue pour les tiers dans l'ensemble, y compris les réévaluations périodiques, les recertifications (p. ex. examens annuels ou fondés sur le déclenchement) et les examens axés sur les événements à la suite d'incidents ou de changements importants.
- Posséder la configuration et l'amélioration continue de la plate-forme TPRM, y compris les workflows, les questionnaires, les modèles de notation, les structures de données et les rôles des utilisateurs, pour soutenir une gestion des risques efficace, cohérente et axée sur les données.
- Concevoir et fournir une formation, des conseils et des communications sur les processus de gestion des risques, l'utilisation des plates-formes et les bonnes pratiques aux propriétaires d'entreprises et aux fonctions de contrôle, renforcer la sensibilisation aux risques et l'application cohérente du cadre dans l'ensemble du Groupe.
- Agir en tant que point de contact central et conseiller de confiance pour les propriétaires d'entreprises, l'approvisionnement, les services juridiques, la sécurité de l'information, la conformité et la continuité des activités en matière de GRPT, y compris l'examen des clauses contractuelles (p. ex. droits de vérification, protection des données, sous-traitance, sortie et résilience) et influencer les décisions fondées sur le risque.

Exigences et qualifications

Éducation
- Minimum:
- Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent, associé à une expérience professionnelle importante en matière de sécurité de l'information, de gestion des risques, de technologie, de finances ou d'affaires.
- Préféré:
- Diplôme universitaire en sécurité de l'information, informatique, génie, affaires, finances ou une discipline connexe.

Certifications professionnelles / Licences
- Préféré:
- Certifications professionnelles pertinentes en matière de sécurité de l'information ou de gestion des risques (par exemple dans des domaines comme la gestion de la sécurité de l'information, la gestion des risques ou la norme ISO 27001), le cas échéant pour la juridiction.

Expérience professionnelle
- Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans la sécurité de l'information, la gestion des risques, la gestion des fournisseurs/tiers ou des domaines étroitement liés, idéalement dans un environnement mondial ou multigouvernemental.
- Expérience éprouvée de la gestion des risques par des tiers, y compris l'externalisation, les services essentiels, la protection des données, la sécurité de l'information et la résilience opérationnelle dans un environnement réglementé.
- Expérience de travail dans ou avec des services financiers réglementés ou des secteurs aussi fortement réglementés; l'expérience bancaire est un avantage important.
- Expérience pratique avec une plateforme TPRM ou de gestion de fournisseurs, y compris la configuration, la conception de workflow, les structures de données et le support utilisateur.
- Des compétences d'analyse et de pensée critique démontrées, capables de contester l'information, de former des opinions indépendantes et de formuler des recommandations claires et fondées sur le risque sur des relations complexes avec des tiers.
- Fortes compétences en matière d'organisation et de coordination, avec la capacité de gérer simultanément de multiples évaluations par des tiers et des interactions avec les parties prenantes et de donner la priorité efficacement sous pression temporelle.

Connaissances techniques / fonctionnelles
- Connaissance approfondie des cadres de gestion des risques, des méthodologies et des attentes réglementaires des tiers en matière d'externalisation, de sécurité de l'information et de résilience opérationnelle dans les services financiers.
- Une bonne compréhension des principes de la sécurité de l'information et de la protection des données dans leur application aux ententes de tiers, y compris la confidentialité, l'intégrité, la disponibilité, la gestion de l'accès, la gestion des incidents et le traitement des données.
- Compétence dans l'utilisation des outils de flux de travail, des plates-formes d'évaluation des risques et des tableaux de bord axés sur les données, avec la capacité de façonner des processus et des structures de données efficaces au sein de la plate-forme TPRM.
- Un haut niveau de confort avec des données structurées, des questionnaires et des dépôts de données, avec une grande attention aux détails et un engagement pour la qualité des données.

Langues
- Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale, avec la capacité d'expliquer les concepts complexes de risque et de sécurité de manière claire, pragmatique et axée sur l'entreprise aux intervenants non spécialisés.
- Requis : Anglais fluent.
- Préféré : Toute autre langue pertinente à la portée géographique du rôle est un avantage.

Nos valeurs
- Responsabilité : prise en charge des tâches et des défis, et recherche d'amélioration continue
- Hands-on: être proactif pour obtenir rapidement des résultats de haute qualité
- Passionné : être engagé et rechercher l'excellence
- Une solution axée sur les résultats des clients et un traitement équitable des clients avec une prise de conscience des risques
- Orientation vers le partenariat : Promouvoir la collaboration et le travail d'équipe. Travailler ensemble avec un esprit d'entreprise.

summary:
General Info

  • Department: Information Security & Business Continuity Management – Information Security Third Party Risk Management
  • Work time Percentage: 100%- 12 months temporary contract
  • Location: Zurich

Our Company

EFG International is a global private banking group, offering private banking and asset management services. We serve clients in over 40 locations worldwide. EFG International offers a stimulating and dynamic work environment and strives to be an employer of choice. EFG is committed to providing an equitable and inclusive working environment that is founded on the principle of mutual respect. Joining our team means experiencing a supportive environment, where your contributions are valued and recognised. We strongly believe that the diversity of our teams gives us a competitive advantage by fostering better decision-making and greater innovation.

Our Purpose and Mission

Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future. We are a private bank, offering personalised solutions on a global scale to private and institutional clients. Our sustainable success is based on our talents and on how we partner with our clients and communities to create lasting value.

Job Description

We are looking for a temporary (12 month contract) experienced Information Security Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) professional to lead the end‑to‑end TPRM lifecycle for EFG Group. In this Zurich‑based role, you will act as the primary process owner for our global TPRM framework and platform, covering onboarding, risk assessment, due diligence, ongoing monitoring and offboarding of third‑party providers and outsourced services.

Operating within the Information Security & Business Continuity function, you will work autonomously on complex, cross‑functional topics and provide expert challenge and guidance to Procurement, Legal, Compliance, Operational Risk, Business Owners and Business Continuity across multiple jurisdictions. Reporting to the TPRM Manager (under the Group Chief Information Security Officer), you will play a key role in shaping the Group’s medium‑term (1–5 year) third‑party risk posture and control environment, directly influencing decisions that affect operational continuity and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the end‑to‑end onboarding process for new third parties and services in scope of TPRM, ensuring inherent risk assessment, due diligence and approvals are completed before contract signature or service go‑live.
  • Design and apply robust inherent risk scoping for new and existing third‑party relationships, assessing data sensitivity, service criticality, outsourcing status, location and concentration risk to determine the required level of oversight.
  • Direct and coordinate due diligence activities with key control functions (Information Security, Compliance, Legal, Operational Risk, Business Continuity, Procurement), ensuring all relevant risk domains are covered and issues are clearly documented, owned and tracked.
  • Conduct and critically challenge third‑party risk assessments across information security, data protection, operational resilience, financial, compliance and ESG (where applicable), interpreting questionnaires, evidence and certifications using sound professional judgement.
  • Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of third‑party controls, identify gaps and issues, and agree risk‑based remediation actions, timelines and residual risk positions with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, with the third party.
  • Classify third parties into risk tiers and criticality levels based on defined criteria, ensuring that monitoring activities, review frequency and escalation thresholds are aligned with the assigned tier.
  • Lead the implementation and maintenance of ongoing monitoring plans for in‑scope third parties, including periodic reassessments, recertifications (e.g. annual or trigger‑based reviews) and event‑driven reviews following incidents or material changes.
  • Own the configuration and continuous improvement of the TPRM platform, including workflows, questionnaires, scoring models, data structures and user roles, to support efficient, consistent and data‑driven risk management.
  • Design and deliver training, guidance and communication on TPRM processes, platform usage and good practices to Business Owners and control functions, strengthening risk awareness and consistent application of the framework across the Group.
  • Act as a central point of contact and trusted advisor for Business Owners, Procurement, Legal, Information Security, Compliance and Business Continuity on TPRM matters, including review of contractual clauses (e.g. audit rights, data protection, subcontracting, exit and resilience) and influencing risk‑based decisions.

Requirements and Qualifications

Education

  • Minimum:
    • High school diploma or equivalent, combined with substantial relevant professional experience in information security, risk management, technology, finance or business.
  • Preferred:
    • University degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Finance or a related discipline.

Professional Certifications / Licences

  • Preferred:
    • Relevant professional certifications in information security or risk management (for example in areas such as information security management, risk management or ISO 27001), where applicable to the jurisdiction.

Professional Experience

  • At least 10 years of experience in information security, risk management, vendor/third‑party management or closely related fields, ideally in a global or multi‑jurisdictional environment.
  • Proven, hands‑on experience in Third Party Risk Management, including outsourcing, critical services, data protection, information security and operational resilience in a regulated environment.
  • Experience working in or with regulated financial services or similarly highly regulated sectors; banking experience is a strong advantage.
  • Practical experience with a TPRM or vendor management platform, including configuration, workflow design, data structures and user support.
  • Demonstrated analytical and critical‑thinking skills, with the ability to challenge information, form independent views and make clear, risk‑based recommendations on complex third‑party relationships.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple third‑party assessments and stakeholder interactions simultaneously and to prioritise effectively under time pressure.

Technical / Functional Knowledge

  • Deep knowledge of third‑party risk management frameworks, methodologies and regulatory expectations related to outsourcing, information security and operational resilience in financial services.
  • Strong understanding of information security and data protection principles as they apply to third‑party arrangements, including confidentiality, integrity, availability, access management, incident management and data handling.
  • Proficiency in using workflow tools, risk assessment platforms and data‑driven dashboards, with the ability to shape efficient processes and data structures within the TPRM platform.
  • High level of comfort working with structured data, questionnaires and evidence repositories, with strong attention to detail and a commitment to data quality.

Languages

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex risk and security concepts in a clear, pragmatic and business‑oriented way to non‑specialist stakeholders.
  • Required: Fluent English.
  • Preferred: Any additional languages relevant to the role’s geographic scope are an advantage.

Our Values

  • Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement
  • Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results
  • Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence
  • Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset
  • Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

jobs.title: Head of Information Security Management
jobs.description:
General Info

- Department: Information Security & BCM – Group Information Security Management

- Work time Percentage: 100%

- Location: Geneva

Our Company

Our Purpose and Mission

Job Description

We are looking for a seasonned leader to manage our Group-wide Information Security Management function within the Information Security & BCM organisation. In this role, you will define and maintain the information security governance, risk and compliance framework across all EFG entities, ensuring alignment with applicable ICT and operational resilience regulations (including DORA) and recognised industry standards such as ISO, NIST and COBIT.

Acting as the primary interface to senior management, local CISOs and key governance bodies, you will provide Group-level oversight of information security initiatives, control plans and assurance activities that shape EFG’s medium- to long-term resilience and risk profile. You will lead a team of information security professionals, provide functional direction to local Information Security Officers, and steer major change and transformation programmes in the information security and ICT risk space.

This is a highly visible leadership role, offering the opportunity to influence strategic decisions across multiple entities and jurisdictions and to champion a strong culture of information security and operational resilience across the Group.

Key Responsibilities

- Define and lead the Group information security governance framework, including policies, directives, standards and guidelines, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and industry frameworks (ISO, NIST, COBIT) across all EFG entities.

- Integrate and oversee ICT risk management processes, including DORA-driven ICT risk activities, with information security governance so that third-party, data and ICT risks are consistently identified, assessed, mitigated and reported at Group level.

- Steer and monitor the Group information security control plan, including key risk indicators, control certifications and recertifications of special privileges, in close collaboration with ICT Risk Management, to maintain an effective control environment and transparent risk profile.

- Lead major information security change and transformation programmes , such as DORA implementation and ICT risk framework enhancements, ensuring delivery in line with regulatory timelines, Group strategy and the overall information security roadmap.

- Oversee information security–related Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) assessments and ongoing monitoring of security risk exposure, ensuring timely remediation of issues and alignment with the Group TPRM framework owned by the third party risk management and outsourcing function.

- Provide leadership and guidance to local CISOs and Information Security Officers, ensuring consistent application of Group information security policies while accommodating local regulatory and business requirements across multiple jurisdictions.

- Prepare and present regular information security management reporting to senior management and governance bodies (e.g. Information Security Committee), highlighting key risks, control status, incidents, remediation progress and required decisions.

- Act as key contact for internal and external audits on information security management topics, coordinating responses, agreeing remediation plans and tracking closure of findings in partnership with Internal Audit, Compliance and Operational Risk.

- Oversee the portfolio and PMO of information security projects , including planning, prioritisation, progress tracking, dependency management and benefits realisation, ensuring optimal use of resources and alignment with Group priorities.

- Coordinate the information security budget process in collaboration with Finance, including planning, approval and cost tracking for tools, services and external advisory, providing advisory input to the annual budgeting cycle.

- Collaborate closely with IT, ICT Risk Management, Cyber Security Operations, Security Architecture & Project Support, BCM & Resilience, Operational Risk, Compliance and business stakeholders to ensure integrated management of information security and ICT risks.

- Promote a strong risk and security culture across the organisation, communicating complex information security and ICT risk topics in a clear, business-oriented manner to senior management and non-technical stakeholders.

Requirements and Qualifications

Education

- Minimum: Master’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Engineering, Risk Management or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

- Preferred: Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD) in Information Security, Information Risk or a closely related discipline.

Professional Certifications / Licences

- Relevant information security and risk certifications, such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor, or equivalent.

Professional Experience

- Senior information security or ICT risk professional with extensive experience in governance, risk and compliance within the financial services sector, ideally at Group or multi-jurisdictional level.

- At least 15 years of relevant experience in information security, ICT risk or closely related fields, including significant exposure to regulated environments.

- Proven track record in leading cross-functional security initiatives , managing complex regulatory programmes (e.g. DORA, ICT and operational resilience regulations) and interacting with senior management and governance bodies.

- Demonstrated experience in managing and developing teams (3–7 direct reports or similar), as well as providing matrix leadership and functional direction to stakeholders across multiple locations.

- Experience in steering major change and transformation programmes in information security and ICT risk, including project portfolio oversight and budget responsibility or advisory input.

Technical / Functional Knowledge

- Strong knowledge of information security frameworks (e.g. ISO, NIST, COBIT) and ICT / operational resilience regulations, including DORA, and their practical implementation in a regulated financial services environment.

- Deep understanding of ICT risk management, Third Party Risk Management, operational resilience, Business Continuity Management (BCM) and cyber security operations, and how these disciplines integrate into Group information security governance.

- Familiarity with key information security tools and platforms used for control monitoring, risk metrics, assurance activities (e.g. red teaming, cyber table-top exercises, SWIFT/SIC attestations, cyber insurance) and management reporting.

- Strong ability to translate complex technical and risk topics into clear, concise messages for senior management and non-technical stakeholders, enabling informed decision-making on risk and investment.

Languages

- English: Fluent (primary working language).

- Additional languages such as German, French or Italian at business-proficient level are a strong asset.

Our Values

- Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement

- Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

- Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence

- Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

- Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.
