General Info

Department: Group Risk – Third-Party Risk Management and Outsourcing
Work time Percentage: 100%
Location: Zurich

Our Company

EFG International is a global private banking group, offering private banking and asset management services. We serve clients in over 40 locations worldwide. EFG International offers a stimulating and dynamic work environment and strives to be an employer of choice. EFG is committed to providing an equitable and inclusive working environment that is founded on the principle of mutual respect. Joining our team means experiencing a supportive environment, where your contributions are valued and recognised. We strongly believe that the diversity of our teams gives us a competitive advantage by fostering better decision-making and greater innovation.

Our Purpose and Mission

Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future. We are a private bank, offering personalised solutions on a global scale to private and institutional clients. Our sustainable success is based on our talents and on how we partner with our clients and communities to create lasting value.

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) professional to join our Group TPRM and Outsourcing function. In this senior role, you will be responsible for overseeing and driving the effective implementation, execution, and continuous enhancement of EFG’s Third-Party Risk Management framework across all relevant business divisions, legal entities, and geographies.

Reporting to the Head of TPRM and Outsourcing, you will provide both strategic and operational leadership across the TPRM portfolio (including intragroup arrangements) and lifecycle, ensuring consistent application of group-wide policies, standards, governance requirements, and risk management practices. You will have specific accountability for TPRM tooling and system governance, centralised issue and action tracking, portfolio oversight, and the monitoring of control effectiveness and remediation activities.

Acting as a key interface between Group TPRM, business and control functions, technology, procurement, operational risk, compliance, information security, and other relevant stakeholders, you will ensure that third-party risks are appropriately identified, assessed, monitored, escalated, and managed throughout the third-party lifecycle, in line with the Group’s risk appetite, regulatory obligations, and strategic objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the implementation and ongoing enhancement of the Group’s TPRM framework across the full third-party lifecycle, from initial risk classification and due diligence through onboarding, ongoing monitoring, periodic reassessment, and termination.
  • Ensure consistent application of group-wide TPRM policies, standards, methodologies, procedures, and minimum control requirements across business divisions, legal entities, and key geographies, including intragroup arrangements.
  • Maintain group-wide oversight of the third-party portfolio, providing clear visibility of critical and material Outsourcing and ICT third parties, inherent and residual risk exposures, and key risk concentrations.
  • Design, develop, and maintain management information, dashboards, KPIs, and KRIs that enable effective monitoring of portfolio health, lifecycle adherence, remediation progress, and control effectiveness for senior management and risk committees.
  • Establish and oversee a robust, centralised process for recording, tracking, and closing TPRM-related issues, findings, control deficiencies, and remediation actions arising from risk assessments, control testing, audits, regulatory reviews, and incidents.
  • Own the functional governance of the Group’s TPRM tooling and supporting systems, including configuration, workflows, risk assessment methodologies, approval authorities, access controls, data standards, and reporting capabilities, in close collaboration with IT and data management.
  • Coordinate responses to internal audit, external audit, regulatory reviews, and other independent assurance activities related to TPRM, ensuring timely, high-quality submissions and clear demonstration of framework effectiveness and auditability.
  • Act as a senior point of coordination between TPRM and Outsourcing and key stakeholders such as Procurement, Operational Risk, Compliance, Information Security, Technology, Legal, Business Continuity, and regional/local TPRM teams to promote consistent implementation of group-wide requirements.
  • Lead group-wide TPRM change and continuous improvement initiatives, translating strategic objectives into structured delivery plans, and driving execution to enhance efficiency, maturity, automation, and scalability of TPRM processes and governance.
  • Analyse recurring issues, emerging risk trends, and thematic findings to identify systemic weaknesses, concentration risks, and critical service dependencies, and propose sustainable improvements to the TPRM operating model and control environment.

Requirements and Qualifications

Education
Minimum: University degree in finance, business, risk management, information systems, or a closely related discipline.
Preferred: Postgraduate degree and/or relevant professional qualifications in risk management, compliance, or governance.

Professional Experience
Significant experience (typically 8+ years) in third-party risk management, operational risk management, risk governance, or a closely related discipline within banking or another highly regulated financial services environment.
Proven track record in managing complex, cross-border third-party risk portfolios and operating within global stakeholder environments involving business units, control functions, procurement, technology, and regional risk teams.
Demonstrated experience in issue and action management, remediation oversight, control assurance, and closure of audit or regulatory findings.
Experience providing senior management reporting and supporting risk committees or governance forums.

Technical and Functional Knowledge
Strong understanding of the end-to-end third-party risk management lifecycle, including risk classification, due diligence, risk assessment, ongoing monitoring, remediation, and exit management.
Sound and up-to-date knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements and supervisory expectations related to Outsourcing, ICT third parties, and operational resilience in financial services.
Expertise in risk governance, management information, portfolio oversight, KPI/KRI development, and data-driven risk analysis.
Solid analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to challenge data and qualitative information and form independent, well-reasoned views.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex risk concepts in a clear, pragmatic, and business-oriented manner.
Proven experience overseeing TPRM platforms, workflow tools, system governance, data quality, and technology-enabled risk management processes is a strong advantage.
Collaborative mindset, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams and build strong relationships with stakeholders at different levels of the organisation.

Languages
Fluent English (written and spoken) is required.
Additional languages commonly used within EFG’s locations (such as German, French, or Italian) are an advantage.

Our Values

Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement.

Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results.

Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence.

Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset.

Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

Please ensure to attach a cover letter to your CV when filling the application.

jobs.title: EPM OneStream Developer/Business Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Our Company

EFG International is a global private banking group, offering private banking and asset management services. We serve clients in over 40 locations worldwide. EFG International offers a stimulating and dynamic work environment and strives to be an employer of choice.

Our Purpose and Mission

Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future.

Job Description

The EPM OneStream Developer/Business Data Analyst will be part of the Group Performance Measurement, Budgeting & Reporting Team in Lugano and will contribute to develop and run an integrated planning, reporting and performance review process to facilitate value-driven business decision-making. In his role as EPM OneStream Developer, the resource will oversee running, maintenance and development of our existing OneStream planning platform. In his role as EPM OneStream Developer/Business Data Analyst, the resource will support the performance measurement activities by running granular analysis of financial performance root causes and by providing insights on value creation levers.

The resource will play an active role supporting business development and providing value-added decision support using data modelling and forecasting intelligence.

Main Responsibilities

- EPM OneStream Developer

- Business analyst and power user of MI data

- Design and maintain data models for analysis and forecasting

- Establish and compile dashboards and presentations to senior management

- Take active role in the business performance dialogues

- Active collaboration with Strategy & Corporate Development unit during budgeting and forecasting process

- Design and develop MI reports and simulations with data from the various MIS systems of the bank to provide insight on value creation levers to the business

- Develop strong relationship with business management and business controllers to support the Planning & Controlling business partnership

Skills and experience

- Professional experience in EPM Business Intelligence in Financial Industry

- OneStream software: EPM applications maintenance and developments expert

- Ability to understand large datasets and experience of data modelling, providing accurate data analysis

- Power user of OneStream, MS-PowerBI, MS-Excel and PowerPoint; Knowledge of Excel Macros, VBA, Python, SAS Enterprise Guide to automate data extraction and reporting

- Quick learner, accurate and efficient

- Proactive attitude and willingness to take on new knowledge and skills

- Ability to work under pressure and adapt to unforeseen work demands

- Good communication skills to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels

- Fluent in Italian and English

Our Values

- Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement

- Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

- Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence

- Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

- Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

jobs.title: Pension Fund Manager
jobs.description:
## Job Summary

The Pension Fund Manager is in charge of managing and administering the company pension fund, ensuring compliance with current regulations and protection of the interests of the employees of affiliated companies against the economic consequences of old age, death, and disability. He/she coordinates all operational, financial, and administrative activities of the pension fund, in line with the foundation regulations, policies and legal provisions.

## Tasks and Responsibilities

- Overall responsibility for the administrative management, technical-accounting and business activities of Fondazione

- Define the financial and actuarial regulations and parameters underlying the plan in order to achieve long-term financial equilibrium

- Administrative and operational management of the pension fund, including enrolment of members, management of contributions and benefits.

- Supervises the establishment of the Annual Report, the accounting and actuarial reporting to the foundation board and the supervisory bodies as well as the reporting according to IAS 19 to EFG SA

- Coordination with external bodies (actuarial consultants, auditors, supervisory authorities) and service providers (custodian banks, asset managers).

- Supervision of pension fund investments, in accordance with the investment regulations and risk criteria.

- Supervision and control of annual accounts, financial statements and documentation required by supervisory bodies.

- Supporting the Board of Foundation in defining the pension fund's strategy, ensuring the financial stability of the foundation

- Managing communications to members, including information on benefits and regulatory changes.

- Monitoring regulatory developments in the field of pensions and updating internal procedures.

- Supervises the internal control system

- Ensure constant collaboration with the human resources department of EFG SA, agreeing procedures, identifying synergies and jointly analysing common topics

- Prepare and coordinate the meetings of the foundation board and investment committee, drawing up the relevant minutes

- Actively provide pension advice to all insured persons (active employees and pensioners.

## Requirements and Qualifications

- Degree in Economics, Finance, Actuarial Science or related disciplines.

- Proven experience in the management of pension funds, provident funds or similar institutions.

- Sound knowledge of pension legislation (e.g. LOB in Switzerland or equivalent local legislation).

- Expertise in financial management and investment supervision.

- Excellent organisational, analytical and interpersonal skills.

- Advanced knowledge of IT tools for pension management and reporting.

- Managerial competences.

- Languages: Italian, English – German and French are assets

## Working Relationships

The Administration of the Foundation is composed of a small team, where collaboration between the Pension Fund Manager and all other roles of the Team is essential.

The role implies frequent interactions with Board members, external auditors, actuaries, human resources office, reinsurer, investment advisory, responsible of investment mandates, relationship manager of the Custodian Bank.

## Decision-Making & Autonomy

Autonomous and structured management of all tasks, with a global overview of the entire operations of the Foundation.

Plans and organizes activities quickly, recognizing priorities, formulating solutions appropriate to the circumstances. Communicates his views to colleagues in a timely manner, seeking to promote transparency, circulation of information within the team and process efficiency.

## Working Conditions

Work in EFG Office Lugano with frequent travel to EFG offices or to service providers (Actuary, Investment Controller, cooperating financial institutions, …) in Geneva or Zurich.

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Job Summary

The Pension Fund Manager is in charge of managing and administering the company pension fund, ensuring compliance with current regulations and protection of the interests of the employees of affiliated companies against the economic consequences of old age, death, and disability. He/she coordinates all operational, financial, and administrative activities of the pension fund, in line with the foundation regulations, policies and legal provisions.

## Tasks and Responsibilities

- Overall responsibility for the administrative management, technical-accounting and business activities of Fondazione

- Define the financial and actuarial regulations and parameters underlying the plan in order to achieve long-term financial equilibrium

- Administrative and operational management of the pension fund, including enrolment of members, management of contributions and benefits.

- Supervises the establishment of the Annual Report, the accounting and actuarial reporting to the foundation board and the supervisory bodies as well as the reporting according to IAS 19 to EFG SA

- Coordination with external bodies (actuarial consultants, auditors, supervisory authorities) and service providers (custodian banks, asset managers).

- Supervision of pension fund investments, in accordance with the investment regulations and risk criteria.

- Supervision and control of annual accounts, financial statements and documentation required by supervisory bodies.

- Supporting the Board of Foundation in defining the pension fund's strategy, ensuring the financial stability of the foundation

- Managing communications to members, including information on benefits and regulatory changes.

- Monitoring regulatory developments in the field of pensions and updating internal procedures.

- Supervises the internal control system

- Ensure constant collaboration with the human resources department of EFG SA, agreeing procedures, identifying synergies and jointly analysing common topics

- Prepare and coordinate the meetings of the foundation board and investment committee, drawing up the relevant minutes

- Actively provide pension advice to all insured persons (active employees and pensioners.

## Requirements and Qualifications

- Degree in Economics, Finance, Actuarial Science or related disciplines.

- Proven experience in the management of pension funds, provident funds or similar institutions.

- Sound knowledge of pension legislation (e.g. LOB in Switzerland or equivalent local legislation).

- Expertise in financial management and investment supervision.

- Excellent organisational, analytical and interpersonal skills.

- Advanced knowledge of IT tools for pension management and reporting.

- Managerial competences.

- Languages: Italian, English – German and French are assets

## Working Relationships

The Administration of the Foundation is composed of a small team, where collaboration between the Pension Fund Manager and all other roles of the Team is essential.

The role implies frequent interactions with Board members, external auditors, actuaries, human resources office, reinsurer, investment advisory, responsible of investment mandates, relationship manager of the Custodian Bank.

## Decision-Making & Autonomy

Autonomous and structured management of all tasks, with a global overview of the entire operations of the Foundation.

Plans and organizes activities quickly, recognizing priorities, formulating solutions appropriate to the circumstances. Communicates his views to colleagues in a timely manner, seeking to promote transparency, circulation of information within the team and process efficiency.

## Working Conditions

Work in EFG Office Lugano with frequent travel to EFG offices or to service providers (Actuary, Investment Controller, cooperating financial institutions, …) in Geneva or Zurich.
descriptionByLocale.it:
Sintesi del Lavoro Il Responsabile del Fondo Pensionistico è incaricato della gestione e dell'amministrazione del fondo pensionistico dell'azienda, garantendo il rispetto delle normative vigenti e la protezione degli interessi dei dipendenti delle società affiliate contro le conseguenze economiche dell'età avanzata, della morte e dell'invalidità. Coordina tutte le attività operative, finanziarie e amministrative del fondo pensionistico, in linea con i regolamenti della fondazione, le politiche e le disposizioni legali.

## Compiti e Responsabilità
- Responsabilità complessiva della gestione amministrativa, tecnico-contabile e operativa della Fondazione
- Definizione delle regolamentazioni e dei parametri attuariali sottostanti il piano al fine di raggiungere un equilibrio finanziario a lungo termine
- Gestione amministrativa e operativa del fondo pensionistico, inclusa l'iscrizione dei membri, la gestione delle contribuzioni e dei benefici
- Supervisione della redazione del Rapporto Annuale, della contabilità e della relazione attuariale alla board della fondazione e agli organismi di controllo, nonché del reporting secondo IAS 19 a EFG SA
- Coordinamento con enti esterni (consulenti attuariali, revisori, autorità di controllo) e fornitori di servizi (banche custodi, gestori di asset)
- Supervisione degli investimenti del fondo pensionistico, in conformità con le regolamentazioni di investimento e i criteri di rischio
- Supervisione e controllo dei conti annuali, delle dichiarazioni finanziarie e della documentazione richiesta dagli organismi di controllo
- Supporto alla Board della Fondazione nella definizione della strategia del fondo pensionistico, garantendo la stabilità finanziaria della fondazione
- Gestione delle comunicazioni ai membri, inclusa l'informazione sui benefici e le modifiche normative
- Monitoraggio dello sviluppo normativo nel campo delle pensioni e aggiornamento delle procedure interne
- Supervisione del sistema di controllo interno
- Garanzia di una costante collaborazione con il dipartimento risorse umane di EFG SA, concordando procedure, identificando sinergie e analizzando insieme temi comuni
- Preparazione e coordinamento delle riunioni della board della fondazione e del comitato di investimento, redigendo le relative minute
- Fornire attivamente consulenza pensionistica a tutti i beneficiari (dipendenti attivi e pensionati)

## Requisiti e Qualifiche
- Laurea in Economia, Finanza, Scienze Attuariali o discipline correlate
- Esperienza comprovata nella gestione di fondi pensionistici, fondi di previdenza o istituzioni simili
- Conoscenza solida della legislazione pensionistica (es. LOB in Svizzera o legislazione locale equivalente)
- Competenza nella gestione finanziaria e supervisione degli investimenti
- Eccellenti capacità organizzative, analitiche e interpersonali
- Conoscenza avanzata degli strumenti informatici per la gestione e il reporting pensionistico
- Competenze manageriali
- Lingue: Italiano, Inglese – Tedesco e Francese sono un vantaggio

## Relazioni Lavorative L'amministrazione della Fondazione è composta da un piccolo team, dove la collaborazione tra il Responsabile del Fondo Pensionistico e tutti gli altri ruoli del Team è essenziale. Il ruolo implica interazioni frequenti con i membri della Board, revisori esterni, attuari, ufficio risorse umane, riassicuratore, consulente di investimento, responsabile degli incarichi di investimento, manager di relazione della banca custode.

## Decisioni e Autonomia Gestione autonoma e strutturata di tutte le attività, con una visione globale di tutte le operazioni della Fondazione. Pianifica e organizza rapidamente le attività, riconoscendo le priorità, formulando soluzioni appropriate alle circostanze. Comunica tempestivamente le proprie opinioni ai colleghi, promuovendo trasparenza, circolazione delle informazioni all'interno del team e efficienza dei processi.

## Condizioni di Lavoro Lavoro in ufficio EFG a Lugano con frequenti viaggi verso gli uffici EFG o i fornitori di servizi (Attuario, Controllore degli Investimenti, istituti finanziari collaborativi, ...) a Ginevra o Zurigo.

Stellenüberblick Der Stiftungsleiter ist verantwortlich für die Verwaltung und Administration des Unternehmenspensionsfonds, wobei die Einhaltung der geltenden Vorschriften und der Schutz der Interessen der Mitarbeiter der verbundenen Unternehmen vor den wirtschaftlichen Folgen des hohen Alters, des Todes und der Behinderung gewährleistet werden. Er/sie koordiniert alle operativen, finanziellen und administrativen Aktivitäten des Pensionsfonds gemäß den Stiftungsregelungen, Politiken und gesetzlichen Bestimmungen.

## Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten
- Gesamte Verantwortung für die administrative Verwaltung, technisch-kontabile und geschäftliche Aktivitäten der Stiftung
- Definition der finanziellen und versicherungsmathematischen Regelungen und Parameter, die den Plan unterliegen, um eine langfristige finanzielle Gleichgewicht zu erreichen
- Administrative und operative Verwaltung des Pensionsfonds, einschließlich der Registrierung der Mitglieder, der Verwaltung von Beiträgen und Leistungen
- Überwachung der Erstellung des Jahresberichts, der Buchhaltung und der versicherungsmathematischen Berichte an den Stiftungsrat und die Aufsichtsbehörden sowie der Berichte gemäß IAS 19 an EFG SA
- Koordination mit externen Stellen (versicherungsmathematische Berater, Prüfer, Aufsichtsbehörden) und Dienstleistern (Treuhänderbanken, Vermögensverwalter)
- Überwachung der Pensionsfonds-Investitionen gemäß den Investitionsregelungen und Risikokriterien
- Überwachung und Kontrolle der Jahresrechnungen, Finanzberichte und Dokumentationen, die von den Aufsichtsbehörden gefordert werden
- Unterstützung des Stiftungsrates bei der Definition der Strategie des Pensionsfonds, Sicherstellung der finanziellen Stabilität der Stiftung
- Verwaltung der Kommunikation mit den Mitgliedern, einschließlich Informationen zu Leistungen und regulatorischen Änderungen
- Überwachung der regulatorischen Entwicklungen im Bereich der Pensionsvorsorge und Aktualisierung der internen Verfahren
- Überwachung des internen Kontrollsystems
- Sicherstellung der konstanten Zusammenarbeit mit dem Personalabteilung von EFG SA, Vereinbarung von Verfahren, Identifizierung von Synergien und gemeinsame Analyse von gemeinsamen Themen
- Vorbereitung und Koordination der Sitzungen des Stiftungsrats und des Investmentkomitees, Erstellung der entsprechenden Protokolle
- Aktive Beratung in Sachen Pensionsvorsorge für alle Versicherten (aktive Mitarbeiter und Pensionäre)

## Anforderungen und Qualifikationen
- Abschluss in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Finanzwissenschaften, Versicherungsmathematik oder verwandten Disziplinen
- Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Verwaltung von Pensionsfonds, Vorsorgefonds oder ähnlichen Institutionen
- Solides Wissen über Pensionsgesetzgebung (z. B. LOB in der Schweiz oder vergleichbare lokale Gesetzgebung)
- Expertise in der Finanzverwaltung und Überwachung von Investitionen
- Ausgezeichnete organisatorische, analytische und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten
- Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in IT-Tools für Pensionsverwaltung und Berichterstattung
- Führungskompetenzen
- Sprachen: Italienisch, Englisch – Deutsch und Französisch sind ein Vorteil

## Arbeitsbeziehungen Die Verwaltung der Stiftung besteht aus einem kleinen Team, in dem die Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem Stiftungsleiter und allen anderen Rollen des Teams entscheidend ist. Die Rolle beinhaltet häufige Interaktionen mit Mitgliedern des Vorstands, externen Prüfern, Versicherungsmathematikern, Personalabteilung, Rückversicherer, Investmentberater, Verantwortlichen für Investmentaufträge, Relationship Manager der Treuhänderbank.

## Entscheidungsfindung & Autonomie Autonomes und strukturiertes Management aller Aufgaben mit einem globalen Überblick über alle Operationen der Stiftung. Planung und Organisation der Aktivitäten rasch, Prioritäten erkennen, Lösungen entsprechend der Umstände formulieren. Ansichten gegenüber Kolleginnen und Kollegen rechtzeitig kommunizieren, um Transparenz, Informationsfluss innerhalb des Teams und Prozess-effizienz zu fördern.

## Arbeitsbedingungen Arbeiten im EFG-Büro in Lugano mit häufigen Reisen zu EFG-Büros oder Dienstleistern (Versicherungsmathematiker, Investmentcontroller, kooperierende Finanzinstitute, ...) in Genf oder Zürich.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Résumé du poste Le Gestionnaire du Fonds de Pension est chargé de la gestion et de l'administration du fonds de pension de l'entreprise, en veillant à respecter les réglementations en vigueur et à protéger les intérêts des employés des sociétés affiliées contre les conséquences économiques de la vieillesse, du décès et de l'incapacité. Il/elle coordonne toutes les activités opérationnelles, financières et administratives du fonds de pension, conformément aux règlements de la fondation, aux politiques et aux dispositions légales.

## Tâches et Responsabilités
- Responsabilité globale de la gestion administrative, technique-comptable et opérationnelle de la Fondation
- Définition des règlements et paramètres actuariels sous-jacents au plan afin d'atteindre un équilibre financier à long terme
- Gestion administrative et opérationnelle du fonds de pension, y compris l'inscription des membres, la gestion des cotisations et des prestations
- Supervision de l'établissement du Rapport Annuel, de la comptabilité et du reporting actuariel au conseil de la fondation et aux organismes de contrôle, ainsi que du reporting selon IAS 19 vers EFG SA
- Coordination avec les organismes externes (conseillers actuariels, auditeurs, autorités de contrôle) et les prestataires de services (banques dépositaires, gestionnaires d'actifs)
- Supervision des investissements du fonds de pension, conformément aux règlements d'investissement et critères de risque
- Supervision et contrôle des comptes annuels, états financiers et documents requis par les organismes de contrôle
- Soutien au Conseil de la Fondation dans la définition de la stratégie du fonds de pension, en garantissant la stabilité financière de la fondation
- Gestion des communications aux membres, y compris les informations sur les prestations et les changements réglementaires
- Suivi des développements réglementaires dans le domaine des retraites et mise à jour des procédures internes
- Supervision du système de contrôle interne
- Garantir une collaboration constante avec le service des ressources humaines d'EFG SA, en définissant des procédures, en identifiant des synergies et en analysant conjointement des sujets communs
- Préparation et coordination des réunions du conseil de la fondation et du comité d'investissement, en rédigeant les procès-verbaux correspondants
- Fournir activement des conseils en matière de retraite à tous les assurés (employés actifs et retraités)

## Exigences et Qualifications
- Diplôme en Économie, Finance, Science Actuarielle ou disciplines connexes
- Expérience prouvée dans la gestion de fonds de pension, de fonds de prévoyance ou d'institutions similaires
- Bonnes connaissances de la législation sur les retraites (ex. LOB en Suisse ou législation locale équivalente)
- Expertise en gestion financière et supervision des investissements
- Excellentes compétences organisationnelles, analytiques et interpersonnelles
- Connaissances avancées des outils informatiques pour la gestion et le reporting des retraites
- Compétences managériales
- Langues : Italien, Anglais – Allemand et Français sont un atout

## Relations de Travail L'administration de la Fondation est composée d'une petite équipe, où la collaboration entre le Gestionnaire du Fonds de Pension et tous les autres rôles de l'équipe est essentielle. Le poste implique des interactions fréquentes avec les membres du Conseil, auditeurs externes, actuaires, service des ressources humaines, réassureur, conseiller en investissement, responsable des mandats d'investissement, manager de relation de la banque dépositaire.

## Prise de Décision & Autonomie Gestion autonome et structurée de toutes les tâches, avec une vue d'ensemble globale de toutes les opérations de la Fondation. Planification et organisation rapides des activités, reconnaissance des priorités, formulation de solutions adaptées aux circonstances. Communication en temps voulu des points de vue aux collègues, en visant à promouvoir la transparence, le flux d'informations au sein de l'équipe et l'efficacité des processus.

## Conditions de Travail Travail au bureau EFG à Lugano avec des déplacements fréquents vers les bureaux EFG ou les prestataires de services (Actuaire, Contrôleur des Investissements, institutions financières collaboratives, ...) à Genève ou Zurich.

jobs.title: Global IT head of Identity Governance & Access Control
jobs.description:
General Info

· Department: IT & Digital

· Work time Percentage: 100%

· Location: Geneva

Our Company

Our Purpose and Mission

Job Description

We are looking for a Global Head of Identity Governance & Access Control to lead EFG’s global User Access Management (UAM) and Identity Governance function.

In this role, you will be responsible for defining and executing the bank’s strategy for identity lifecycle and access governance, ensuring secure, accurate and compliant access to systems and data across entities and business lines.

Reporting to the Global Head of IT Support, you will manage a global team and oversee the end‑to‑end access lifecycle, including access provisioning and deprovisioning, periodic access reviews and recertifications, and the design and maintenance of role‑based access models.

You will drive the implementation and continuous enhancement of the bank’s identity governance framework and tools, working closely with IT, Information Security, Architecture, Business and HR stakeholders.

You will act as the primary point of contact for internal and external audits on identity and access topics, ensuring robust controls, clear documentation and effective remediation of findings.

The role combines strategic leadership, operational excellence and strong stakeholder management in a highly regulated, control‑intensive environment.

For this IT / technology‑focused role, we keep the description of tools and platforms at a high level in the job ad. More detailed information on the technology stack and specific solutions can be shared with shortlisted candidates at a later stage of the recruitment process. No confidential or security‑sensitive details about EFG’s internal security architecture or processes are disclosed externally.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and develop the global User Access Management and Identity Governance function, providing strategic direction, coaching and day‑to‑day leadership to a team and additional indirect reports.

- Oversee end‑to‑end identity and access lifecycle processes (joiners, movers, leavers), ensuring timely, accurate and compliant access provisioning and deprovisioning across systems and applications, while keeping external communications free of sensitive security configurations or architectures.

- Design, maintain and continuously improve the bank’s role‑based access and business role models, including the management of deviations and segregation‑of‑duties considerations, in close collaboration with Business, IT, Information Security, Risk, Compliance and HR stakeholders.

- Plan and run periodic access review and recertification campaigns, ensuring that access rights remain appropriate, well‑controlled and aligned with regulatory and internal policy requirements.

- Lead the bank’s identity governance programme, defining the roadmap, onboarding applications to the central governance platform, and simplifying and standardising access‑related processes in partnership with IT, Security, Architecture, Business and HR.

- Act as primary point of contact for internal and external auditors on identity and access topics, preparing and presenting evidence, reports and remediation plans, while ensuring that externally shared information remains high‑level and does not reveal sensitive security details.

- Establish and monitor key performance and risk indicators for identity and access management, driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance control effectiveness, operational efficiency and user experience.

- Manage the relationship and service delivery with external providers supporting identity and access services, including performance oversight and budget responsibility for both run‑the‑bank and change‑the‑bank activities.

- Represent the UAM/IGA function in steering committees, governance forums and senior management meetings, providing clear, business‑oriented updates on key initiatives, risks and issues related to identity and access.

Requirements and Qualifications

Education

- Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Security, Engineering or a related field (minimum requirement).

- Additional business or management education (for example an MBA) is an asset.

- Relevant security or identity & access management certifications (for example in information security or audit) are a strong advantage.

-
Project or programme management certifications are considered an advantage.

Professional Experience

- At least 5 years of experience in Identity & Access Management / Identity Governance, including several years in a senior leadership role with responsibility for teams and complex environments.

- Proven track record in implementing and operating identity governance solutions and role‑based access models in a large, regulated organisation.

- Experience in banking or another highly regulated, control‑intensive industry (for example financial services, luxury, pharmaceuticals).

-
Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi‑stakeholder programmes and interacting with internal and external auditors and senior management.

Technical and Functional Knowledge

- Deep understanding of identity and access management concepts, including identity lifecycle, provisioning and deprovisioning, access recertification, role‑based access control and segregation of duties.

- Strong knowledge of access control models and business role design, with the ability to define pragmatic, scalable solutions that balance control and usability.

- Familiarity with information security standards and control frameworks and with regulatory expectations in the financial sector.

- Good understanding of application architectures and integration patterns (on‑premise, cloud, SaaS) relevant to access management, without disclosing internal security architecture or specific configurations in external materials.

-
Ability to translate technical identity and access topics into clear, business‑oriented language and governance decisions for senior stakeholders.

Languages and Personal Skills

- Fluency in English and French (spoken and written) is required; additional languages are an advantage.

- Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with a rigorous risk and control mindset and a focus on continuous improvement.

- Mature leadership capabilities, with the ability to coach and develop a senior team and to influence stakeholders across Business, IT, Security and senior management.

-
High level of integrity, accountability and professionalism, aligned with EFG’s values and culture.

Our Values

· Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement

· Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

· Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence

· Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

· Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

-

Technical and Functional Knowledge

- Strong knowledge of access control models and business role design, with the ability to define pragmatic, scalable solutions that balance control and usability.
- Familiarity with information security standards and control frameworks and with regulatory expectations in the financial sector.
- Good understanding of application architectures and integration patterns (on‑premise, cloud, SaaS) relevant to access management, without disclosing internal security architecture or specific configurations in external materials.

-
Ability to translate technical identity and access topics into clear, business‑oriented language and governance decisions for senior stakeholders.

Languages and Personal Skills
- Fluency in English and French (spoken and written) is required; additional languages are an advantage.
- Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with a rigorous risk and control mindset and a focus on continuous improvement.

High level of integrity, accountability and professionalism, aligned with EFG’s values and culture.

Our Values

Descrizione del lavoro

Stiamo cercando un responsabile globale della governance e del controllo dell'accesso all'identità per guidare la gestione globale dell'accesso agli utenti (EFG.s) e la funzione di governo dell'identità.

In questo ruolo, sarete responsabili della definizione e dell'esecuzione della strategia della banca per il ciclo di vita delle identità e la governance degli accessi, garantendo un accesso sicuro, accurato e conforme ai sistemi e ai dati tra entità e linee di business.

In relazione al capo mondiale del supporto informatico, gestirà un team globale e supervisionerà il ciclo di vita dell'accesso end-to-end, compresi la fornitura e la disfornitura dell'accesso, revisioni e ricertificazioni periodiche dell'accesso, nonché la progettazione e la manutenzione di modelli di accesso basati su ruoli.

Tu guiderai l'implementazione e il continuo miglioramento del quadro di governance e degli strumenti di identità della banca, lavorando a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder IT, Information Security, Architecture, Business e HR.

Sarai il punto di contatto principale per audit interni ed esterni su temi di identità e accesso, garantendo controlli solidi, una chiara documentazione e un'efficace bonifica dei risultati.

Il ruolo combina leadership strategica, eccellenza operativa e una gestione forte delle parti interessate in un ambiente fortemente regolamentato e ad alta intensità di controllo.

Per questo ruolo IT/tecnologicamente focalizzato, manteniamo la descrizione degli strumenti e delle piattaforme ad un livello elevato nell'annuncio di lavoro. Informazioni più dettagliate sullo stack tecnologico e soluzioni specifiche possono essere condivise con candidati selezionati in una fase successiva del processo di reclutamento. Non vengono comunicati dettagli riservati o sensibili alla sicurezza sull'architettura o sui processi di sicurezza interni dell'EFG.s all'esterno.

Responsabilità chiave
- Leader e sviluppare la funzione globale di gestione dell'accesso agli utenti e di governance dell'identità, fornendo indicazioni strategiche, coaching e leadership quotidiana a una squadra e ulteriori relazioni indirette.
- Superare i processi di identificazione e di accesso end-to-end (uniti, mover, users), garantendo la fornitura e la disfornitura di accessi tempestivi, accurati e conformi tra sistemi e applicazioni, mantenendo nel contempo le comunicazioni esterne libere da configurazioni o architetture di sicurezza sensibili.
- Progettare, mantenere e migliorare continuamente i modelli di accesso e di ruolo delle banche, compresi la gestione delle deviazioni e delle considerazioni di segregazione, in stretta collaborazione con le parti interessate delle imprese, dell'informatica, della sicurezza dell'informazione, del rischio, della conformità e delle risorse umane.
- Pianificare e condurre campagne periodiche di revisione e ricertificazione dell'accesso, assicurando che i diritti di accesso rimangano adeguati, ben controllati e allineati con i requisiti normativi e politici interni.
- Guidare il programma di governance dell'identità della banca, definire la tabella di marcia, integrare le applicazioni alla piattaforma centrale di governance e semplificare e standardizzare i processi connessi all'accesso in partenariato con IT, Sicurezza, Architettura, Business e HR.
- Agire come punto di contatto primario per i revisori interni ed esterni su temi di identità e accesso, preparare e presentare prove, relazioni e piani di bonifica, assicurando al contempo che le informazioni condivise esternamente rimangano di alto livello e non rivelino dettagli sensibili in materia di sicurezza.
- Stabilire e monitorare indicatori chiave di performance e di rischio per la gestione dell'identità e dell'accesso, stimolando iniziative di miglioramento continuo per migliorare l'efficacia dei controlli, l'efficienza operativa e l'esperienza degli utenti.
- Gestire i rapporti e la prestazione di servizi con fornitori esterni a sostegno dei servizi di identità e accesso, compresa la sorveglianza delle prestazioni e la responsabilità di bilancio per le attività sia di gestione della banca che di cambiamento della banca.
- Rappresentare la funzione

Requisiti e qualifiche

Istruzione
- Laurea magistrale (o equivalente) in Informatica, Sistemi informativi, Sicurezza dell'informazione, Ingegneria o un campo correlato (requisito minimo).
- L'istruzione supplementare di impresa o di gestione (per esempio un MBA) è un bene.

-
Le certificazioni di gestione di progetti o programmi sono considerate un vantaggio.

Esperienza professionale
- Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione dell'identità e dell'accesso / governance dell'identità, inclusi diversi anni in un ruolo di leadership senior con responsabilità per i team e gli ambienti complessi.
- Proven ha fatto il suo tempo nell'implementazione e nell'attuazione di soluzioni di governance dell'identità e di modelli di accesso basati sui ruoli in un'organizzazione grande e regolamentata.
- Esperienza nel settore bancario o in un'altra industria ad alta regolamentazione, ad alta intensità di controllo (ad esempio servizi finanziari, lusso, prodotti farmaceutici).

-
Esperienza dimostrata nella gestione di programmi complessi e multipartecipativi e nell'interazione con revisori interni ed esterni e alti dirigenti.

Conoscenze tecniche e funzionali
- una comprensione approfondita dei concetti di gestione dell'identità e dell'accesso, compreso il ciclo di vita dell'identità, la fornitura e il defornimento, la ricertificazione dell'accesso, il controllo dell'accesso basato sui ruoli e la segregazione dei compiti.

Lingue e competenze personali

Unsere Firma

Unser Zweck und unsere Mission

Aufgabenbeschreibung

Wir suchen einen Global Head of Identity Governance & Access Control, der die Funktion EFG, das globale User Access Management (UAM) und Identity Governance leitet.

In dieser Rolle sind Sie für die Festlegung und Durchführung der Strategie der Bank, für den Identitäts-Lebenszyklus und die Zugangskontrolle verantwortlich, die einen sicheren, genauen und konformen Zugang zu Systemen und Daten über Unternehmen und Geschäftsfelder hinweg gewährleistet.

Sie werden dem globalen Leiter des IT-Supports unterstellt, ein globales Team verwalten und den Lebenszyklus des End-to-End-Zugangs überwachen, einschließlich der Bereitstellung und Entzerrung von Zugangsmöglichkeiten, regelmäßigen Überprüfungen und Rezertifizierungen sowie der Gestaltung und Pflege von rollenbasierten Zugangsmodellen.

Sie werden die Implementierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Bank, Identity Governance Framework und Tools vorantreiben, eng mit IT, Information Security, Architektur, Business und HR Stakeholdern zusammenarbeiten.

Sie fungieren als primäre Anlaufstelle für interne und externe Audits zu Identitäts- und Zugangsbereichen, gewährleisten robuste Kontrollen, klare Dokumentation und effektive Sanierung von Erkenntnissen.

Die Rolle verbindet strategische Führung, operative Exzellenz und ein starkes Stakeholder-Management in einem stark regulierten, kontrollintensiven Umfeld.

Für diese IT / technologieorientierte Rolle halten wir die Beschreibung von Werkzeugen und Plattformen auf hohem Niveau in der Stellenanzeige. Detailliertere Informationen zum Technologiestack und zu spezifischen Lösungen können mit kurzfristigen Kandidaten zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt des Rekrutierungsprozesses geteilt werden. Keine vertraulichen oder sicherheitsrelevanten Details über EFG, die interne Sicherheitsarchitektur oder Prozesse werden extern offengelegt.

Wichtige Aufgaben
- Führen und entwickeln Sie die globale Funktion User Access Management und Identity Governance, die strategische Ausrichtung, Coaching und tägliche Führung für ein Team und zusätzliche indirekte Berichte bietet.
- Die End-to-End-Prozesse für Identität und Zugang zum Lebenszyklus (Joiners, Movers, Leavers) sind zu beachten, um eine rechtzeitige, genaue und konforme Bereitstellung und Deprovision von Zugangsmöglichkeiten über Systeme und Anwendungen hinweg zu gewährleisten und gleichzeitig die externe Kommunikation frei von sensiblen Sicherheitskonfigurationen oder Architekturen zu halten.
- Konzipieren, pflegen und kontinuierlich verbessern Sie die Bank, ihre rollenbasierten Zugangs- und Geschäftsrollenmodelle, einschließlich des Managements von Abweichungen und der Überlegungen zur Trennung zwischen Unternehmen und Unternehmen, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Interessenträgern Unternehmen, IT, Informationssicherheit, Risiko, Compliance und HR.
- Planen und führen regelmäßige Kampagnen zur Überprüfung und Neuzertifizierung des Zugangs durch, um sicherzustellen, dass die Zugangsrechte angemessen, kontrolliert und an die Anforderungen der Regulierungs- und internen Politik angepasst bleiben.
- Leiten Sie das Programm zur Identity Governance der Bank, definieren Sie den Fahrplan, bordeigene Anwendungen zur zentralen Governance-Plattform und vereinfachen Sie und standardisieren Sie die Zugangsprozesse in Partnerschaft mit IT, Sicherheit, Architektur, Unternehmen und HR.
- Als vorrangige Anlaufstelle für interne und externe Prüfer in Bezug auf Identitäts- und Zugangsthemen zu handeln, Beweise, Berichte und Sanierungspläne auszuarbeiten und vorzulegen, wobei gleichzeitig sichergestellt wird, dass die externen Informationen weiterhin auf hohem Niveau sind und keine sensiblen Sicherheitsdaten offengelegt werden.
- Festlegung und Überwachung der wichtigsten Leistungs- und Risikoindikatoren für Identitäts- und Zugangsmanagement, die kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen zur Verbesserung der Kontrolleffizienz, der operativen Effizienz und der Benutzererfahrung vorantreiben.
- Verwaltung der Beziehungen und der Erbringung von Dienstleistungen mit externen Anbietern, die Identitäts- und Zugangsdienste unterstützen, einschließlich der Leistungsaufsicht und der Haushaltsverantwortung für die laufenden Bank- und Änderungstätigkeiten der Bank.
- Vertretung der Funktion UAM/IGA in Lenkungsausschüssen, Governance-Foren und Sitzungen der Geschäftsleitung, die klare, unternehmensorientierte Aktualisierungen zu wichtigen Initiativen, Risiken und Fragen im Zusammenhang mit Identität und Zugang ermöglichen.

Anforderungen und Qualifikationen

Bildung
- Master (oder gleichwertig) in Informatik, Informationssystemen, Informationssicherheit, Ingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Bereich (Mindestanforderung).
- Zusätzliche Unternehmens- oder Managementausbildung (z.B. ein MBA) ist ein Vorteil.
- Relevante Sicherheits- oder Identitäts- und Zugangsmanagement-Zertifizierungen (z.B. in der Informationssicherheit oder im Audit) sind ein starker Vorteil.

-
Die Zertifizierungen für Projekt- oder Programmmanagement werden als Vorteil betrachtet.

Berufserfahrung
- Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Identity & Access Management / Identity Governance, darunter mehrere Jahre in einer leitenden Rolle mit Verantwortung für Teams und komplexe Umgebungen.
- Bewährte Erfolgsbilanz bei der Umsetzung und dem Betrieb von Identity Governance-Lösungen und rollenbasierten Zugangsmodellen in einer großen, regulierten Organisation.
- Erfahrungen im Bankwesen oder einer anderen stark regulierten, kontrollintensiven Industrie (z.B. Finanzdienstleistungen, Luxus, Pharmazeutika).

-
Nachweis der Erfahrung mit komplexen, multi-stakeholder-Programmen und der Interaktion mit internen und externen Prüfern und Führungskräften.

Technisches und funktionales Wissen
- Vertiefung des Verständnisses von Identitäts- und Zugangsmanagementkonzepten, einschließlich des Lebenszyklus der Identität, Bereitstellung und Entzerrung, Rezertifizierung des Zugangs, rollenbasierte Zugangskontrolle und Aufgabentrennung.
- Starke Kenntnisse von Zugangskontrollmodellen und Business-Rollen-Design, mit der Fähigkeit, pragmatische, skalierbare Lösungen zu definieren, die Kontrolle und Benutzerfreundlichkeit ausgleichen.
- Vertrautheit mit Standards und Kontrollrahmen für die Informationssicherheit und mit regulatorischen Erwartungen im Finanzsektor.
- Ein gutes Verständnis der Anwendungsarchitekturen und Integrationsmuster (on-premise, cloud, SaaS) für das Zugriffsmanagement, ohne die interne Sicherheitsarchitektur oder spezifische Konfigurationen in externen Materialien zu veröffentlichen.

-
Fähigkeit, technische Identität und Zugang zu Themen in klare, geschäftsorientierte Sprach- und Governance-Entscheidungen für hochrangige Interessenträger umzusetzen.

Sprachen und persönliche Fähigkeiten
- Eine fließende Englisch- und Französischsprache (ausgesprochen und geschrieben) ist erforderlich; zusätzliche Sprachen sind ein Vorteil.
- Starke analytische und Problemlösungskompetenzen mit einer strengen Risiko- und Kontrollorientierung und einem Fokus auf kontinuierliche Verbesserungen.
- Reife Führungsfunktionen, mit der Fähigkeit, ein Senior Team zu coachen und zu entwickeln und Stakeholder in den Bereichen Business, IT, Security und Senior Management zu beeinflussen.

-
Hohe Integrität, Rechenschaftspflicht und Professionalität, ausgerichtet auf das EFG, seine Werte und Kultur.

Unsere Werte

· Rechenschaftspflicht: Verantwortung für Aufgaben und Herausforderungen übernehmen, sowie kontinuierliche Verbesserung suchen

· Hands-on: Proaktiv sein, um schnell qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse zu liefern

· Leidenschaftlich: Engagement und Streben nach Exzellenz

· Lösungsorientiert: Fokussierung auf Kundenergebnisse und Behandlung von Kunden mit einem risikobewussten Mindset

· Partnerschaftsorientiert: Förderung der Zusammenarbeit und der Teamarbeit. Zusammenarbeit mit Unternehmergeist.

Notre société

Notre but et notre mission

Description de l'emploi

Nous cherchons un responsable mondial de la gouvernance d'identité et du contrôle d'accès pour diriger la fonction EFG, la gestion globale de l'accès aux utilisateurs (UAM) et la gouvernance d'identité.

Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de la définition et de l'exécution de la stratégie de la banque pour le cycle de vie de l'identité et la gouvernance de l'accès, assurant un accès sécurisé, précis et conforme aux systèmes et données des entités et des secteurs d'activité.

Sous l'autorité du chef mondial du soutien informatique, vous gérerez une équipe mondiale et superviserez le cycle de vie de bout en bout de l'accès, y compris la fourniture et la déprovision de l'accès, les examens et les recertifications périodiques de l'accès, ainsi que la conception et la maintenance de modèles d'accès fondés sur des rôles.

Vous dirigerez la mise en oeuvre et l'amélioration continue de la banque, cadre de gouvernance de l'identité et des outils, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants en TI, sécurité de l'information, architecture, affaires et RH.

Vous agirez comme principal point de contact pour les vérifications internes et externes sur les sujets d'identité et d'accès, assurant des contrôles solides, une documentation claire et une remise en état efficace des constatations.

Le rôle consiste à combiner leadership stratégique, excellence opérationnelle et gestion solide des intervenants dans un environnement hautement réglementé et à forte intensité de contrôle.

Pour ce rôle axé sur les technologies de l'information, nous conservons la description des outils et des plateformes à un haut niveau dans la publicité d'emploi. Des informations plus détaillées sur la pile technologique et les solutions spécifiques peuvent être partagées avec les candidats présélectionnés à une étape ultérieure du processus de recrutement.

Principales responsabilités
- Diriger et développer la fonction mondiale de gestion de l'accès des utilisateurs et de gouvernance de l'identité, en fournissant une orientation stratégique, un encadrement et un leadership quotidien à une équipe et en fournissant des rapports indirects supplémentaires.
- Surveiller les processus d'identification et d'accès de bout en bout (joiners, déménageurs, sortants), assurer la fourniture et la déprovision d'accès en temps opportun, précis et conforme à l'ensemble des systèmes et des applications, tout en préservant les communications externes sans configurations ou architectures de sécurité sensibles.
- Conception, maintien et amélioration continue de la banque, des modèles d'accès à l'information et des modèles opérationnels fondés sur les rôles, y compris la gestion des écarts et des considérations de séparation des droits, en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants des secteurs des affaires, de la TI, de la sécurité de l'information, du risque, de la conformité et des RH.
- Planifier et mener des campagnes périodiques d'examen et de requalification des accès, en veillant à ce que les droits d'accès demeurent appropriés, bien contrôlés et conformes aux exigences réglementaires et internes.
- Diriger la banque, le programme de gouvernance de l'identité, définir la feuille de route, intégrer les applications à la plate-forme de gouvernance centrale, et simplifier et normaliser les processus liés à l'accès en partenariat avec les TI, la sécurité, l'architecture, les affaires et les RH.
- Agir comme point de contact principal pour les vérificateurs internes et externes sur les sujets d'identité et d'accès, préparer et présenter des preuves, des rapports et des plans d'assainissement, tout en veillant à ce que l'information partagée à l'extérieur demeure de haut niveau et ne révèle pas de détails de sécurité sensibles.
- Établir et surveiller les indicateurs de rendement et de risque clés pour la gestion de l'identité et de l'accès, en menant des initiatives d'amélioration continue afin d'améliorer l'efficacité du contrôle, l'efficience opérationnelle et l'expérience des utilisateurs.
- Gérer les relations et la prestation de services avec les fournisseurs externes qui soutiennent les services d'identité et d'accès, y compris la surveillance du rendement et la responsabilité budgétaire des activités de gestion de la banque et de changement de la banque.
- Représenter la fonction UAM/IGA dans les comités directeurs, les forums de gouvernance et les réunions de la haute direction, en fournissant des mises à jour claires et axées sur les activités sur les initiatives clés, les risques et les questions liées à l'identité et à l'accès.

Exigences et qualifications

Éducation
- Maîtrise ou équivalent en informatique, systèmes d'information, sécurité de l'information, génie ou domaine connexe (exigence minimale).
- La formation supplémentaire en gestion ou en affaires (par exemple, une AAM) est un atout.
- Les certifications pertinentes en matière de sécurité ou d'identité et de gestion des accès (par exemple en matière de sécurité de l'information ou de vérification) constituent un avantage important.

-
Les certifications de gestion de projet ou de programme sont considérées comme un avantage.

Expérience professionnelle
- Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en gestion de l'identité et de l'accès / gouvernance de l'identité, y compris plusieurs années dans un rôle de leadership supérieur avec responsabilité pour les équipes et les environnements complexes.
- Prouvez des antécédents dans la mise en œuvre et l'exploitation de solutions de gouvernance d'identité et de modèles d'accès basés sur des rôles dans une grande organisation réglementée.
- Expérience dans le secteur bancaire ou dans une autre industrie hautement réglementée et à forte intensité de contrôle (par exemple, services financiers, luxe, produits pharmaceutiques).

-
Expérience démontrée en gestion de programmes complexes et multipartites et en interaction avec les auditeurs internes et externes et la haute direction.

Connaissances techniques et fonctionnelles
- Connaissance approfondie des concepts de gestion de l'identité et de l'accès, y compris le cycle de vie de l'identité, la fourniture et la déprovision, la requalification de l'accès, le contrôle de l'accès fondé sur le rôle et la séparation des tâches.
- Une connaissance approfondie des modèles de contrôle d'accès et de la conception des rôles d'affaires, avec la capacité de définir des solutions pragmatiques et évolutives qui équilibrent contrôle et convivialité.
- Connaissance des normes et des cadres de contrôle de la sécurité de l'information et des attentes réglementaires dans le secteur financier.
- Bonne compréhension des architectures d'application et des modèles d'intégration (sur prémise, cloud, SaaS) pertinents pour la gestion des accès, sans divulguer l'architecture de sécurité interne ou des configurations spécifiques dans des matériaux externes.

-
Capacité de traduire l'identité technique et d'accéder aux sujets en un langage clair et orienté vers les affaires et en décisions de gouvernance pour les intervenants supérieurs.

Langues et compétences personnelles
- Il faut une bonne maîtrise de l'anglais et du français (parler et écrire); les langues supplémentaires sont un avantage.
- De solides compétences analytiques et de résolution de problèmes, avec un état d'esprit rigoureux de risque et de contrôle et un accent sur l'amélioration continue.
- Capacités de leadership matures, avec la capacité d'entraîner et de développer une équipe de cadres supérieurs et d'influencer les intervenants dans les domaines des affaires, de la TI, de la sécurité et de la haute direction.

-
Niveau élevé d'intégrité, de responsabilité et de professionnalisme, en harmonie avec la FEG, les valeurs et la culture.

Nos valeurs

· Responsabilité : prendre en main les tâches et les défis, et chercher à améliorer continuellement

· Mains sur les pieds : être proactif pour obtenir rapidement des résultats de haute qualité

· Passionné : être engagé et s'efforcer d'atteindre l'excellence

· Solution : Se concentrer sur les résultats des clients et traiter les clients équitablement en tenant compte des risques

· Objectif partenariat : Promouvoir la collaboration et le travail d'équipe.

EFG International offers a stimulating and dynamic work environment and strives to be an employer of choice. EFG is committed to providing an equitable and inclusive working environment that is founded on the principle of mutual respect. Joining our team means experiencing a supportive environment, where your contributions are valued and recognised. We strongly believe that the diversity of our teams gives us a competitive advantage by fostering better decision-making and greater innovation.

Our Purpose and Mission

Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future. We are a private bank, offering personalised solutions on a global scale to private and institutional clients. Our sustainable success is based on our talents and on how we partner with our clients and communities to create lasting value.

Job Description

We are looking for a Global Head of Identity Governance & Access Control to lead EFG’s global User Access Management (UAM) and Identity Governance function.

In this role, you will be responsible for defining and executing the bank’s strategy for identity lifecycle and access governance, ensuring secure, accurate and compliant access to systems and data across entities and business lines.

Reporting to the Global Head of IT Support, you will manage a global team and oversee the end‑to‑end access lifecycle, including access provisioning and deprovisioning, periodic access reviews and recertifications, and the design and maintenance of role‑based access models.

You will drive the implementation and continuous enhancement of the bank’s identity governance framework and tools, working closely with IT, Information Security, Architecture, Business and HR stakeholders.

You will act as the primary point of contact for internal and external audits on identity and access topics, ensuring robust controls, clear documentation and effective remediation of findings.

The role combines strategic leadership, operational excellence and strong stakeholder management in a highly regulated, control‑intensive environment.

For this IT / technology‑focused role, we keep the description of tools and platforms at a high level in the job ad. More detailed information on the technology stack and specific solutions can be shared with shortlisted candidates at a later stage of the recruitment process. No confidential or security‑sensitive details about EFG’s internal security architecture or processes are disclosed externally.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the global User Access Management and Identity Governance function, providing strategic direction, coaching and day‑to‑day leadership to a team and additional indirect reports.
  • Oversee end‑to‑end identity and access lifecycle processes (joiners, movers, leavers), ensuring timely, accurate and compliant access provisioning and deprovisioning across systems and applications, while keeping external communications free of sensitive security configurations or architectures.
  • Design, maintain and continuously improve the bank’s role‑based access and business role models, including the management of deviations and segregation‑of‑duties considerations, in close collaboration with Business, IT, Information Security, Risk, Compliance and HR stakeholders.
  • Plan and run periodic access review and recertification campaigns, ensuring that access rights remain appropriate, well‑controlled and aligned with regulatory and internal policy requirements.
  • Lead the bank’s identity governance programme, defining the roadmap, onboarding applications to the central governance platform, and simplifying and standardising access‑related processes in partnership with IT, Security, Architecture, Business and HR.
  • Act as primary point of contact for internal and external auditors on identity and access topics, preparing and presenting evidence, reports and remediation plans, while ensuring that externally shared information remains high‑level and does not reveal sensitive security details.
  • Establish and monitor key performance and risk indicators for identity and access management, driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance control effectiveness, operational efficiency and user experience.
  • Manage the relationship and service delivery with external providers supporting identity and access services, including performance oversight and budget responsibility for both run‑the‑bank and change‑the‑bank activities.
  • Represent the UAM/IGA function in steering committees, governance forums and senior management meetings, providing clear, business‑oriented updates on key initiatives, risks and issues related to identity and access.

Requirements and Qualifications

Education

  • Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Security, Engineering or a related field (minimum requirement).
  • Additional business or management education (for example an MBA) is an asset.
  • Relevant security or identity & access management certifications (for example in information security or audit) are a strong advantage.

  • Project or programme management certifications are considered an advantage.

Professional Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in Identity & Access Management / Identity Governance, including several years in a senior leadership role with responsibility for teams and complex environments.
  • Proven track record in implementing and operating identity governance solutions and role‑based access models in a large, regulated organisation.
  • Experience in banking or another highly regulated, control‑intensive industry (for example financial services, luxury, pharmaceuticals).

  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi‑stakeholder programmes and interacting with internal and external auditors and senior management.

Technical and Functional Knowledge

  • Deep understanding of identity and access management concepts, including identity lifecycle, provisioning and deprovisioning, access recertification, role‑based access control and segregation of duties.
  • Strong knowledge of access control models and business role design, with the ability to define pragmatic, scalable solutions that balance control and usability.
  • Familiarity with information security standards and control frameworks and with regulatory expectations in the financial sector.
  • Good understanding of application architectures and integration patterns (on‑premise, cloud, SaaS) relevant to access management, without disclosing internal security architecture or specific configurations in external materials.

  • Ability to translate technical identity and access topics into clear, business‑oriented language and governance decisions for senior stakeholders.

Languages and Personal Skills

  • Fluency in English and French (spoken and written) is required; additional languages are an advantage.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with a rigorous risk and control mindset and a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Mature leadership capabilities, with the ability to coach and develop a senior team and to influence stakeholders across Business, IT, Security and senior management.

  • High level of integrity, accountability and professionalism, aligned with EFG’s values and culture.

Our Values

· Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement

· Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

· Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence

· Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

· Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

jobs.description:
Job Title

ERP Project Intern - Finance

Department

Finance

Location

Geneva

Job Description

The ERP Project Finance intern will support the Finance department in a strategic project to select and implement a new ERP system for the bank. Working closely with Finance, IT and Project Management, the intern will help gather and structure requirements, analyse ERP solutions, support vendor evaluations, contribute to project documentation and coordination, and, after selection, participate in the preparation and early stages of the ERP implementation.

Top of Form

Main Responsibilities

- Project & Coordination Support
- Assist the project manager and Finance lead in planning and tracking project activities, milestones and deliverables.

- Prepare and maintain project documentation (meeting minutes, action logs, status reports, presentations).

- Finance Requirements & Process Analysis
- Support the collection and documentation of Finance requirements (e.g. general ledger, AP/AR, fixed assets, consolidation, reporting).

- Help map and document current Finance processes and contribute to defining target (“to be”) processes.

- Assist in structuring and prioritising requirements into clear lists or matrices.

- ERP & Vendor Evaluation Support
- Contribute to the preparation of RFI/RFP materials (questionnaires, requirement catalogues, evaluation criteria).

- Help collect and compare information on ERP vendors and solutions from a Finance perspective (functional coverage, reporting, controls, integration with banking systems).

- Support the preparation of comparison summaries, evaluation scorecards and decision support material.

- Workshops, Demos & Stakeholder Engagement
- Help organise workshops, vendor demos and Finance stakeholder meetings.

- Support the preparation of demo scripts and use cases relevant for Finance.

- Capture feedback from participants and help consolidate it into structured evaluation outputs.

- Data, Reporting & Documentation
- Assist in preparing data samples, templates and simple analyses required during the selection phase.

- Maintain well-structured documentation and shared repositories (requirements, decisions, risks, open points).

- Risk, Controls & Compliance (Finance Focus)
- Support the documentation of key Finance control and compliance aspects (e.g. segregation of duties, audit trail, closing controls), under guidance from senior staff.

- Implementation Preparation & Support (Post Selection)
- After ERP selection, support preparation activities for implementation (e.g. refinement of requirements, validation of design assumptions, planning of Finance-related tasks).

- Assist in activities such as test case preparation, data preparation, and coordination with Finance users during early implementation phases.

- Help document lessons learned and feedback from Finance stakeholders during the initial implementation steps.

Profile / Background

- Education
- Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field.

- Technical & Analytical Skills
- Strong analytical skills and ability to structure and synthesise information.

- Good command of office tools, in particular spreadsheets and presentations.

- Interest in ERP systems and Finance/Accounting processes.

- Soft Skills
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to work collaboratively with Finance, IT and other stakeholders.

- High attention to detail, reliability and good organisational skills.

- Proactive, curious and willing to learn in a project driven environment.

- Languages
- Very good command of English and French (written and spoken).

Skills and experience

- Preferred initial exposure to accounting or ERP/finance systems (e.g. through coursework, internships or student projects).

- Basic understanding of banking or financial services.

- Experience working in teams on projects or case studies.

What we Offer

- Direct involvement in a strategic ERP selection and early implementation project within the Finance function.

- Practical exposure to Finance processes, ERP solutions and project management in a banking environment.

- Opportunity to collaborate with experienced Finance and IT professionals.

- A learning oriented environment with regular guidance and feedback.

Our Values

-
Accountability : Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement

-
Hands-on : Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

-
Passionate : Being committed and striving for excellence

-
Solution-driven : Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

-
Partnership-oriented : Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Titolo del lavoro

Interno del progetto ERP
- Finanza

Dipartimento

Finanza

Location

Ginevra

Descrizione del lavoro

Lo stage ERP Project Finance supporterà il dipartimento Finance in un progetto strategico per selezionare e implementare un nuovo sistema ERP per la banca. Lavorando a stretto contatto con Finance, IT e Project Management, lo stage aiuterà a raccogliere e strutturare i requisiti, analizzare le soluzioni ERP, sostenere le valutazioni dei fornitori, contribuire alla documentazione e al coordinamento del progetto, e, dopo la selezione, partecipare alla preparazione e alle prime fasi dell'implementazione ERP.

Top of Form

Principali responsabilità
- Project & Coordination Support
- Assistere il project manager e Finance condurre nella pianificazione e monitoraggio delle attività del progetto, pietre miliari e consegnabili.
- Preparare e mantenere la documentazione del progetto (meeting minutes, action logs, report di stato, presentazioni).
- Requisiti di finanza e analisi dei processi
- Sostenere la raccolta e la documentazione dei requisiti di finanza (ad esempio, registro generale, AP/AR, attività fisse, consolidamento, reporting).
- Aiutare la mappa e documentare i processi Finance attuali e contribuire a definire i processi di destinazione (“da essere”).
- Assistere nella strutturazione e priorità dei requisiti in liste o matrici chiare.
- Supporto di valutazione ERP & Vendor
- Contribuire alla preparazione dei materiali RFI/RFP (questionario, cataloghi requisiti, criteri di valutazione).
- Aiuta a raccogliere e confrontare le informazioni sui fornitori e le soluzioni ERP da una prospettiva Finance (copertura funzionale, reporting, controlli, integrazione con i sistemi bancari).
- Sostenere la preparazione di sintesi di confronto, schede di valutazione e materiale di supporto decisionale.
- Workshop, Demos & Stakeholder Engagement
- Aiuta a organizzare workshop, demo di fornitori e riunioni di stakeholder Finance.
- Sostenere la preparazione di script demo e casi di utilizzo rilevanti per la finanza.
- Cattura il feedback dei partecipanti e aiuta a consolidarlo in output di valutazione strutturati.
- Dati, Rapporti e Documentazione
- Assistere nella preparazione di campioni di dati, modelli e analisi semplici richieste durante la fase di selezione.
- Mantenere documentazione ben strutturata e depositi condivisi (requisiti, decisioni, rischi, punti aperti).
- Rischio, Controlli e conformità (Finance Focus)
- Sostenere la documentazione dei principali aspetti di controllo delle finanze e di conformità (ad esempio la segregazione dei doveri, il percorso di audit, i controlli di chiusura), sotto la guida del personale senior.
- Preparazione e supporto per l'attuazione (Selezione post)
- Dopo la selezione dell'ERP, supporta le attività di preparazione per l'implementazione (ad esempio la raffinatezza dei requisiti, la convalida dei presupposti di progettazione, la pianificazione dei compiti connessi alla finanza).
- Assistere in attività come la preparazione dei casi di prova, la preparazione dei dati e il coordinamento con gli utenti Finance durante le prime fasi di attuazione.
- Aiuta le lezioni di documento imparate e il feedback da parte degli stakeholder Finance durante le fasi iniziali di attuazione.

Profilo / sfondo
- Istruzione
- Attualmente iscritta a una laurea o Master in Finanza, Contabilità, Business Administration, Sistemi Informativi, o un campo relativo.
- Abilità tecniche e analitiche
- Forte capacità analitiche e capacità di struttura e sintesi delle informazioni.
- Buon comando di strumenti di ufficio, in particolare fogli di calcolo e presentazioni.
- Interessi nei sistemi ERP e nei processi Finance/Accounting.
- Abilità morbide
- Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale.
- Capacità di lavorare in collaborazione con Finance, IT e altri stakeholder.
- Alta attenzione ai dettagli, affidabilità e buone capacità organizzative.
- Proattivo, curioso e disposto a imparare in un ambiente guidato dal progetto.
- Lingue
- Ottimo comando di inglese e francese (scritto e parlato).

Competenze ed esperienza
- Preferita esposizione iniziale ai sistemi contabili o di finanziamento ERP/ (ad esempio attraverso corsi, stage o progetti di studenti).
- La comprensione di base dei servizi bancari o finanziari.
- Esperienza di lavoro in team su progetti o studi di casi.

Cosa offriamo
- Il coinvolgimento diretto in una selezione strategica dell'ERP e in un progetto di implementazione precoce all'interno della funzione Finance.
- Esposizione pratica ai processi Finance, alle soluzioni ERP e alla gestione dei progetti in un ambiente bancario.
- Opportunità di collaborare con professionisti esperti di finanza e IT.
- Un ambiente orientato all'apprendimento con guida e feedback regolari.

I nostri valori

-
Responsabilità: Prendere la proprietà per i compiti e le sfide, nonché cercare un miglioramento continuo

-
Hands-on: essere proattivi per fornire rapidamente risultati di alta qualità

-
Passionato: Impegnarsi e lottare per l'eccellenza

-
Soluzione-driven: Concentrarsi sui risultati del cliente e trattare i clienti in modo corretto con una mentalità di rischio

-
Partenariato: promuovere la collaborazione e il lavoro di squadra. Lavorare insieme a uno spirito imprenditoriale.
